text: Thunderstruck gets +2 hit points per player and cannot take more than 4 damage each round.
shadow: Shadow: Either add Thunderstruck to the staging area or deal 2 damage to the defending character.

name: Crowley
text: For each resource on Crowley, he gets +1 [threat], +1 [attack], +1 [defense], and +1 hit points. If Crowley has 3 or more resources on him, he gains victory 3.NNN Forced: When Crowley engages you, place 1 resource on him. At the end of the combat phase, return him to the staging area.

name: Spyglass
text: SideA Action: Exhaust Spyglass to choose one: • Look at a shadow card. • Look at the top and bottom card of your deck. • Place 1 progress on a location (2 progress instead if it is Uncharted). SideB Action: Exhaust Spyglass to choose one: • Look at a shadow card. You may discard it. • Look at the top and bottom card of any deck. • Place 1 progress on a location (4 progress instead if it is Uncharted).
back_text:
When Spyglass leaves play, remove it from the game.
Action: Exhaust Spyglass to choose one:  • Look at a shadow card. You may discard it.  • Look at the top and bottom card of any deck.  • Place 1 progress on a location (4 progress instead if it is Uncharted).

name: Revenant
text: Forced: When 3 or more damage would be placed on Revenant, place 2 damage instead. Forced: After Revenant is destroyed, shuffle it into the encounter deck. Place 1 resource on the campaign card.

name: Black Key
text: SideA Attached character gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. SideB Attached character gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. Response: After attached character quests successfully, place 1 resource on them. Action: Exhaust Black Key and remove 3 resources from attached character to ready them.
back_text:
When Black Key leaves play, remove it from the game.
Attached character gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense].  Response: After attached character quests successfully, place 1 resource on them.  Action: Exhaust Black Key and remove 3 resources from attached character to ready them.

name: Galdor's Counsel
text: Action: Add X resources to any hero’s resource pool. X is half the level of Galdor’s Counsel ([leadership]), rounded up. Add Galdor’s Counsel to the victory display.

name: Galdor's Counsel
text: Action: Deal X damage to a non-unique enemy. X is the level of Galdor’s Counsel ([tactics]). Add Galdor’s Counsel to the victory display.

name: Galdor's Counsel
text: Action: Place X progress on a non-unique location in the staging area. X is the level of Galdor’s Counsel ([spirit]). Add Galdor’s Counsel to the victory display.

name: Galdor's Counsel
text: Action: Look at the top X or bottom X cards of your deck, add any number of them to your hand, and put the rest on the top and/or bottom of your deck in any order. X is half the level of Galdor’s Counsel ([lore]), rounded up. Add Galdor’s Counsel to the victory display.

name: Graxar
text: Graxar gets +1 [attack] for each damage on him and +1 [defense] for each resource on him. Forced: When Graxar is dealt a shadow card, place 1 resource on him.

name: Parrying Cutlass
text: SideA Attached hero gets +1 [defense] (+2 [defense] instead if it has 2 or more resources in its resource pool). SideB Attached hero gets +2 [defense] (+3 [defense] instead if it has 2 or more resources in its resource pool). Response: When attached hero defends against an enemy, exhaust Parrying Cutlass to move 1 resource from that enemy to attached hero’s resource pool.
back_text:
Permanent. Restricted.
Attached hero gets +2 [defense] (+3 [defense] instead if it has 2 or more resources in its resource pool). Response: When attached hero defends against an enemy, exhaust Parrying Cutlass to move 1 resource from that enemy to attached hero's resource pool.

name: Throwing Axe
text: SideA Attached hero gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if it has 2 or more damage on it). SideB Attached hero gets +2 [attack] (+3 [attack] instead if it has 2 or more damage on it) Action: Either deal 1 damage to an enemy, or toss Throwing Axe. If it travels at least two feet across the playing area and stops on any enemies, deal 4 damage to one of them. Reattach Throwing Axe to its hero. (Limit once per game.)
back_text:
Permanent. Restricted.
Attached hero gets +2 [attack] (+3 [attack] instead if it has 2 or more damage on it). Action: Either deal 1 damage to an enemy, or toss Throwing Axe. If it travels at least two feet across the playing area and stops on any enemies, deal 4 damage to one of them. Reattach Throwing Axe to its hero. (Limit once per game.)

name: Black Key
text: SideA Attached enemy gets +1 [threat], +1 [attack], +1 [defense], and gains immune to player card effects. Forced: At the end of the quest phase, if Captain Sahír is in play, place 1 resource on him for each player in the game. SideB Attached enemy gets +1 [threat], +1 [attack], +1 [defense], and gains immune to player card effects.
back_text:
When Black Key leaves play, remove it from the game.
Attached enemy gets +1 [threat], +1 [attack], +1 [defense], and gains immune to player card effects.

name: Calaerion
text: SideA Action: Spend 3 resources and exhaust Calaerion to ready the Dream-chaser and give it +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] until the end of the phase. SideB Response: After a card is discarded from the encounter deck, shuffle it into that deck. (Limit once per round.) Action: Spend 2 resources and exhaust Calaerion to ready another ally and give it +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] until the end of the round.
back_text:
When Calaerion leaves play, remove him from the game.
Response: After a card is discarded from the encounter deck, shuffle it into that deck. (Limit once per round.)  Action: Spend 2 resources and exhaust Calaerion to ready another ally and give it +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] until the end of the round.

name: Come Together
text: Action: Choose up to X characters. X is the level of Come Together, then add it to the victory display. Until the end of the round, each of those characters… ...get +2 [defense] if you control a [leadership] hero. ...get +2 [attack] if you control a [tactics] hero. ...get +2 [willpower] if you control a [spirit] hero. ...gain a Trait of your choice and heal 2 damage from each of them if you control a [lore] hero

name: Sea Serpent
text: SideA Forced: After Sea Serpent attacks and destroys an ally, the defending player deals X damage divided among characters they control. Forced: After Sea Serpent is destroyed, flip it over and put it into play in the staging area. SideB Forced: After Sea Serpent attacks and destroys an ally, the defending player deals X damage divided among characters they control. Forced: At the end of the round, Sea Serpent makes an attack against the first player.
back_text:
Immune to player card effects. X is twice the number of players in the game.
Forced: After Sea Serpent attacks and destroys an ally, the defending player deals X damage divided among characters they control.  Forced: At the end of the round, Sea Serpent makes an attack against the first player.

name: Starla
text: Response: After Starla is discarded from your hand or deck, play her. Response: After Starla exhausts, place 1 progress on a location.

name: Recurring Nightmare
text: When Recurring Nightmare leaves play, shuffle it into any player’s deck. Forced: When Recurring Nightmare enters your hand, add it to the staging area.

name: Command
text: Action: Add Command ([leadership]) to the victory display to choose up to X options, where X is its level: • A hero gets +2 [defense] until the end of the round. • An enemy gets –2 [defense] until the end of the round. • Ready a character with Círdan’s Blessing on it. • Put an ally with cost X or less in your discard pile into play. Discard it at the end of the phase.

name: Command
text: Action: Add Command ([lore]) to the victory display to choose up to X options, where X is its level: • Remove X resources from a non-unique enemy. • Add 2 resources to each Círdan’s Blessing. • Add the bottom card of your deck to your hand. • Look at the top 10 cards of the encounter deck, discard any number of them, and shuffle it.

name: Command
text: Action: Add Command ([spirit]) to the victory display to choose up to X options, where X is its level: • A hero gets +2 [willpower] until the end of the round. • Each character with Círdan’s Blessing on it does not exhaust to commit to a quest this round. • Place 2 progress on a non-unique location. • Put Spyglass into play attached to a hero.

name: Command
text: Action: Add Command ([tactics]) to the victory display to choose up to X options, where X is its level: • A hero gets +2 [attack] until the end of the round. • An enemy gets –2 [attack] until the end of the round. • Deal 2 damage to an enemy. You may engage it. • Ready an attachment. You may move it to an eligible character.

name: Cirdan's Blessing
text: Attach to a character. Cirdan’s Blessing enters play with X resources on it. X is 1 more than the level of Círdan’s Blessing ([leadership]). Response: When attached character defends, remove 1 resource from Cirdan’s Blessing to give that character +3 [defense] for this attack.

name: Cirdan's Blessing
text: Attach to a character. Cirdan’s Blessing enters play with X resources on it. X is 1 more than the level of Círdan’s Blessing ([tactics]). Response: When attached character attacks, remove 1 resource from Cirdan’s Blessing to give that character +3 [attack] for this attack.

name: Cirdan's Blessing
text: Attach to a character. Cirdan’s Blessing enters play with X resources on it. X is 1 more than the level of Círdan’s Blessing ([spirit]). Action: Exhaust Cirdan’s Blessing and remove 1 resource from it to give attached character +3 [willpower] until the end of the phase.

name: Cirdan's Blessing
text: Attach to a hero. Cirdan’s Blessing enters play with X resources on it. X is 1 more than the level of Círdan’s Blessing ([lore]). Response: After the active location is explored, move 1 resource from Cirdan’s Blessing to attached hero’s resource pool. Then, heal 1 damage from attached hero.

name: Gavin
text: Planning Action: Shuffle Gavin and 1 random set-aside Send for Help into the encounter deck. When Revealed: Put Gavin into play under any player’s control committed to the quest. Add 1 resource to Lanwyn’s resource pool, if able.

name: Send for Help
text: When Revealed: Choose a player to search the top 10 cards of their deck for a card, draw it or play it at no cost, and shuffle their deck. If Send for Help ([leadership]) is upgraded, repeat this effect. Remove Send for Help from the game.
shadow: Shadow: Resolve this card's when revealed effect.

name: Send for Help
text: When Revealed: Search the players’ collections for a hero and put it into play under any player’s control. If Send for Help ([tactics]) is upgraded, repeat this effect. At the end of the round, or if those heroes leave play, remove them from the game. Remove Send for Help from the game.
shadow: Shadow: Resolve this card's when revealed effect.

name: Send for Help
text: When Revealed: Choose one: resource, planning, combat, or refresh. After the current phase, there is an additional instance of the chosen phase. If Send for Help ([spirit]) is upgraded, choose two instead (resolve them in any order). Remove Send for Help from the game.
shadow: Shadow: Resolve this card's when revealed effect.

name: Send for Help
text: When Revealed: Search the players’ collections for Gandalf ally (core set 73) and put him into play under any player’s control, ignoring uniqueness. If Send for Help ([lore]) is upgraded, that player chooses up to 3 of Gandalf’s options instead of 1. Remove Send for Help from the game.

name: The Black Sword
text: SideA Captain Sahír gets +2 [attack] and gains indestructible. Forced: After Captain Sahír attacks for the first time each round, he makes an attack against each other player (in turn order). SideB Captain Sahír gains indestructible. Forced: After Captain Sahír attacks for the first time each round, he makes an attack against each other player (in turn order).
back_text:
Immune to player card effects. The Black Sword enters play with 2 resources on it.
Captain Sahír gains indestructible.  Forced: After Captain Sahír attacks for the first time each round, he makes an attack against each other player (in turn order).

name: Denethor
text: Setup: Add 2 resources to Denethor's resource pool. Action: Move 1 resource from Denethor's resource pool to another Gondor hero's resource pool. (Limit once per round.)
flavor: "...why should I sit here in my tower and think, and watch, and wait, spending even my sons? For I can still wield a brand." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Rod of the Steward
text: Attach to a Gondor hero. Action: Spend 2 resources from attached hero's resource pool to draw 1 card.
flavor:
"The last Steward of Gondor begs leave to surrender his office." And he held out a white rod.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: In Service of the Steward
text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains the Gondor trait.
flavor:
But be it known that I have now sworn him to my service...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Azain Silverbeard
text: Response: After Azain Silverbeard participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, spend 1 [tactics] resource to deal 2 damage to another enemy that shares a Trait with the destroyed enemy. Any player may trigger this response.

name: Last Stand
text: Response: After a Warrior character is destroyed while defending against an enemy attack, deal damage to the attacking enemy equal to that character's printed [attack].
flavor:
In a grave alone under the shadow of the Hornburg lay Háma, captain of the King's guard. He fell before the Gate.
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Glorfindel
text: Glorfindel can be played from your discard pile. Action: Discard a card from your hand to ready Glorfindel. (Limit once per phase.)
flavor:
"He is an Elf-lord of a house of princes."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Tides of Fate
text: Response: When a shadow card increases an enemy's [attack] by any amount, increase the defending character's [defense] by 3 for that attack. Then, the players as a group may spend 2 [tactics] resources to ready the defending character and give it +3 [attack] for its next attack this phase.
flavor:
...the tides of fate hd turned against them and their doom was at hand.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Imladris Caregiver
text: Action: Discard a card from your hand to heal 1 damage on any character. (Limit twice per round).
flavor:
"You are in Rivendell, and you need not worry about anything for the present."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Heed the Dream
text: Action: Choose a player. That player searches the top 5 cards of his deck for a card, adds it to his hand, and shuffles his deck. Then, the players as a group may spend 3 [leadership] resources to have that player search his deck for another card, add it to his hand, and shuffle his deck.

name: Guardian of Rivendell
text: As an additional cost to play Guardian of Rivendell from your hand, you must discard 2 cards from your hand.
flavor:
"Indeed there is a power in Rivendell to withstand the might of Mordor, for a while."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Vanish from Sight
text: Play only if you control 2 or fewer heroes. Action: Until the end of the phase, if your threat is higher than 20, treat your threat as if it is 20.
flavor:
"I see now little hope, if we do not soon vanish from sight for a while, and cover our trail."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Lanwyn
text: Ranged. Response: After an encounter card with surge is revealed, either ready Lanwyn or give her +2 [willpower] until the end of the phase. (Limit twice per phase.)
flavor: "The Men of Dale used to have the trick of understanding their language, and used them for messengers to fly to the Men of the Lake..." <cite>Thorin, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Eldahir
text: Sentinel. Action: Spend 1 [lore] resource to look at a facedown shadow card dealt to an engaged enemy. If that card has a shadow effect, Eldahir gets +2 [defense] until the end of the phase. Any player may trigger this action. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Captain's Wisdom
text: Resource Action: Exhaust a Noble hero you control to add 2 resources to that hero's resource pool.
flavor:
...in these days men are slow to believe that a captain can be wise and learned in the scrolls of lore and song, as he is, and yet man of hardihood and swift judgement in the field.
<cite>Beregond, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Master Ironsmith
text: Response: After you play Master Ironsmith from your hand, if you paid all of its resource cost from a single hero's resource pool, attach a Weapon or Armor attachment from your hand or discard pile to that hero without paying its resource cost.

name: Raiment of War
text: Attach to a Warrior character. Raiment of War counts as 2 Restricted attachments. Attached character gets +1 [attack], +1 [defense] and +2 hit points.
flavor:
Now men came bearing raiment of war from the king's hoard...
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Sam Gamgee
text: Reduce the cost to play Sam Gamgee by 2 if you control Frodo Baggins. Response: After a player raises his threat, that player may spend 1 [spirit] resource to ready Sam Gamgee. He gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] until the end of the round. (Limit once per round.)

name: Elevenses
text: Play only after the staging step. Quest Action: Choose X questing Hobbit characters you control. Ready each chosen character and remove them from the quest. Then, reduce your threat by X.
flavor:
"The road goes on for ever," said Pippin; "but I can't without a rest. It is high time for lunch."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Mirkwood Explorer
text: Response: After Mirkwood Explorer quests successfully, place 1 progress on it. Action: Exhaust Mirkwood Explorer to move all progress from it to a location in play.

name: Guarded Ceaselessly
text: Attach to a location. Action: Exhaust a Ranger or Scout character to give attached location -2 [threat] until the end of the phase.
flavor:
"In this high play you may see the two powers that are opposed to one another; and ever they strive now in thought..."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Elfhelm
text: Each [spirit] hero with an attached Mount gets +1 [willpower]. Each [tactics] hero with an attached Mount gets +1 [attack]. Each [leadership] hero with an attached Mount gets +1 [defense].
flavor: Ahead nearer the walls Elfhelm's men were among the siege-engines, hewing, slaying, driving their foes into the fire-pits. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Ceorl
text: Spend 1 [spirit] resource to ready Ceorl. Then, you may give control of Ceorl to another player. Any player may trigger this action. (Limit once per phase).
flavor:
He drew himself up. Then he knelt, offering his notched sword to the king. "Command me, lord!" he cried. 
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Armored Destrier
text: Attach to a [leadership] or sentinel hero. Restricted. Response: After attached hero defends against an attack, exhaust Armored Destrier to ready attached hero. Then, discard a shadow card from another enemy engaged with the defending player.

name: Déorwine
text:
Sentinel.
While Déorwine is defending, he gains: “Response: Spend 1 [leadership] resource to cancel a shadow effect just triggered. Any player may trigger this response.”

name: Revealed in Wrath
text: Play only if you control a Noldor hero. Action: Choose a non-unique enemy. Until the end of the phase, treat the chosen enemy's printed text box as if it were blank (except for Traits).
flavor: "…seeing an Elf-lord revealed in his wrath, they were dismayed, and their horses were stricken with madness." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Rhovanion Outrider
text: Response: After Rhovanion Outrider commits to the quest, place 1 progress on a location in the staging area. If that location is not explored by this effect, give Rhovanion Outrider +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.

name: Scouting Party
text: Response: After you commit characters to the quest, if each character you have committed to the quest is a Scout, each of those characters gets +2 [willpower] until the end of the phase.

name: Entangling Nets
text:
Play Entangling Nets into the staging area unattached.
If unattached, attach Entangling Nets to the next eligible enemy that enters the staging area.
Attached enemy gets –2 [attack] and –2 [defense].

name: Arrows from the Trees
text: Play only after making engagement checks. Encounter Action: If no enemies were engaged this phase, deal 1 damage to each enemy in the staging area. Then, the players as a group may spend 3 [tactics] resources to deal 2 additional damage to each enemy in the staging area.

name: Ered Luin Miner
text: Response: After Ered Luin Miner is discarded from your deck, put it into play under your control.
flavor:
Tools were to be found in plenty that the miners and quarriers and builders of old had used; and at such work the dwarves were still very skilled.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Argalad
text: Ranged. Action: Exhaust Argalad to choose an enemy in the staging area. Until the end of the phase, that enemy gets -X [threat], where X is Argalad's [attack]. If this effect reduces the enemy's [threat] to 0, deal 1 damage to it. (Limit once per round.)

name: Dwarven Sellsword
text: Forced: At the end of the round, discard Dwarven Sellsword unless the players as a group spend 1 [leadership] resource.
flavor:
...he did not altogether approve of dwarves and their love of gold...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Dúnedain Remedy
text: Attach to a hero. Response: After Dúnedain Remedy is attached to a hero, heal 1 damage on that hero. Action: Pay 1 resource from attached hero's resource pool to attach Dúnedain Remedy to another hero.

name: Marksman of Lórien
text: Ranged. Response: After Marksman of Lórien enters play, choose an enemy. That enemy gets -2 [defense] until the end of the round.
flavor:
"Keen are the eyes of the Elves."
<cite>Aragorn, The Two Towers</cite>

name: Battle-fury
text: Play only before the staging step. Quest Action: Exhaust a hero you control to immediately declare it as an attacker (and resolve its attack) against any eligible enemy target. Then, the players as a group may spend 1 [spirit] resource to commit that hero to the quest.
flavor:
Fey he seemed, or the battle-fury of his fathers ran like new fire in his veins...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Woodland Courier
text: Response: After Woodland Courier enters play, place 1 progress on a location (2 progress instead if that location has the Forest trait).

name: Hithlain
text: Attach to a location. Limit 1 per location Response: After a player plays a Silvan ally from his hand, place 1 progress on attached location.
flavor:
He made his end of the rope fast about another tree, and then ran lightly along it, over the river and back again, as if he were on a round.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Robin Smallburrow
text: Response: After you travel to a location, spend 1 [spirit] resource to raise the engagement cost of each enemy in play by X until the end of the round, where X is that location's quest points. Any player may trigger this response.
flavor:
"Gave me a chance of walking round the country and seeing folk, and hearing the news, and knowing where the good beer was."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Interrogation
text: Action: Choose an enemy with an attached Trap card. Look at the top X cards of the encounter deck, where X is that enemy's printed [threat]. You may discard 1 of those cards. Return the rest to the top of the deck, in the same order.

name: Strider
text:
Attach to a hero.
While you control 2 or fewer heroes, attached hero does not exhaust to commit to the quest.
While you control 5 or fewer characters, attached hero gets +2 [willpower].
flavor:
"Strider can take you by paths that are seldom tridden. Will you have him?"
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Na'asiyah
text: Resources in Na'asiyah's resource pool cannot be used to pay for allies. Action: While Na'asiyah is attacking or defending, pay 1 resource from her resource pool to give her +2 [attack] or +2 [defense] for this attack.

name: Rune-master
text: Attach to a Ranger or [leadership] hero. Response: After a Signal attachment is attached to a hero, exhaust Rune-master to add 1 resource to that hero's resource pool.

name: Terrible to Behold
text: Response: After you declare a Noble character as a defender against an attack made by an engaged enemy, return that enemy to the staging area. Then, cancel the attack.
flavor: So great a power and royalty was revealed in Aragorn...that many of the wild men paused, and looked back over their shoulders to the valley, and some looked up doubtfully at the sky. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Veteran Sword-elf
text: Veteran Sword-elf gets +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] for each copy of Veteran Sword-elf in your discard pile.
flavor:
The elves were the first to charge. Their hatred for the goblins is cold and bitter.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Vigilant Guard
text: Attach to a Warrior character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +2 hit points. Response: When another character would be assigned any amount of damage, place 1 of that damage on attached character instead.

name: Knife-work
text: Action: Choose a player. Each enemy engaged with that player gets -1 [defense] until the end of the phase. Then, the players as a group may spend 2 [lore] resources to have the chosen player draw 1 card each time he attacks and destroys an enemy this phase.
flavor:
"Good!" said Legolas. "But my count is now two dozen. It has been knife-work up here."
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Linhir Sea-captain
text: Response: After you play Linhir Sea-captain from your hand, if you paid all of its resouce cost from a single hero's resource pool, both that hero and Linhir Sea-captain do not exhaust to quest this round.

name: Windfola
text: Attach to a [spirit] hero, or to Éowyn. Restricted. Attached character gets +1 [willpower]. Response: After attached character is removed from the quest, exhaust Windfola to commit that character to the quest.
flavor: ...the great grey steed Windfola made little of the burden; for Dernhelm was less in weight than many men, though lithe and well-knit in frame. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Ioreth
text: Cannot attack or defend. Action: Spend 1 [lore] resource and exhaust Ioreth. Then, heal 3 points of damage on a character. Any player may trigger this action.
flavor: Thus spake Ioreth, wise-woman of Gondor: The hands of the king are the hands of a healer, and so shall the rightful king be known. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: The Houses of Healing
text: You may exhaust any number of Healer characters you control as part of this card's cost. Reduce the cost to play this card by 1 for each Healer character you exhaust in this way. Refresh Action: Choose a hero in any player's discard pile. Put that hero into play under its owner's control, with 1 damage token on it.

name: Justice Shall Be Done
text: Limit 1 per deck. Planning Action: Add Justice Shall Be Done to the victory display to draw 3 cards and add 3 resources to the resource pool of each hero you control. At the end of the round, you are eliminated from the game.
flavor:
"...it is the last move in a great jeopardy, and for one side or the other it will bring the end of the game."
<cite>Aragorn, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Prince Imrahil
text: Combat Action: Spend 1 resource from Prince Imrahil's resource pool to search the top 5 cards of your deck for an ally who shares at least 1 Trait with him, and put that ally into play. Shuffle your deck. At the end of the phase, if that ally is still in play, shuffle it into your deck. (Limit once per round.)

name: Knight of the White Tower
text: Knight of the White Tower's resource cost must be paid from a single hero’s resource pool.
flavor:
"...to be only a man of arms of the Guard of the Tower of Gondor is held worthy in the City, and such men have honour in the land." 
<cite>Beregond, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Hold the Line
text: Response: When an enemy attacks a player, that player may declare up to 3 eligible characters as defenders against this attack. Then, the players as a group may spend 2 [tactics] resources to ready each defending character that takes no damage from this attack.

name: Soldier of Dol Amroth
text: Response: After Soldier of Dol Amroth enters play, reduce the cost of the next [tactics] card you play this phase by 1.
flavor:
...he and his knights still held themselves like lords in whom the race of Númenor ran true.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Súlien
text: Action: Spend 1 [lore] resource to exhaust Súlien. Then, each location in the staging area gets –1 [threat] until the end of the phase. Any player may trigger this action.

name: Inspiring Presence
text: Action: Choose a hero you control. Each hero with lower threat cost than the chosen hero gets +2 [defense] until the end of the phase. Then, the players as a group may spend 2 [leadership] resources to give +2 [attack] to each hero with lower threat cost than the chosen hero until the end of the phase.
flavor:
Wherever he came men's hearts would lift again, and the winged shadows pass from memory.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Guardian of Ithilien
text: Response: After Guardian of Ithilien enters play, return an enemy engaged with you to the staging area.
flavor:
From such men the Lord Denethor chose his forayers…to harry the Orcs and other enemies that roamed between the Ephel Dúath and the River.
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Ranger Spear
text: Attach to a Ranger character. Restricted. Attached character gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead when attacking an enemy with an attachment on it).
flavor:
Two had spears in their hands with broad bright heads.
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Prince of Dol Amroth
text: Attach to Prince Imrahil. Price Imrahil gains the Outlands trait. While you control Outlands allies that belong to 4 different spheres, add 1 additional resource to Prince Imrahil's resource pool when you collect resources during the resource phase (if Prince Imrahil is a hero).

name: Turayn
text: Response: After Turayn exhausts, choose another character. The next time that character would be dealt damage this round, cancel 1 of that damage.

name: A Growing Threat
text: When Revealed: Set aside the topmost non-unique, non-objective, non-burden encounter card in the encounter discard pile. During quest resolution, add a copy of that card to the campaign pool, if able. Remove A Growing Threat from the game.

name: Melanwar
text: Response: After the travel phase begins, exhaust Melanwar to place 1 progress on the active location. If you quested unsuccessfully this round, place 3 progress on the active location instead.

name: Isolde
text: Isolde gets +2 [willpower] while she has an Item attachment. Response: After you engage an enemy, ready Isolde.

name: The Threat to Wilderland
text: Setup: Add The Threat to Wilderland to the staging area with X resources on it. X is the campaign card’s part number. Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, remove a resource from The Threat to Wilderland. Then, either raise each player’s threat by 2 or all encounter cards are immune to player card effects until the end of the phase.

name: Dagnir's Spawn
text: Cannot have non-Dragon attachments. X is the campaign card’s part number. When Revealed: Each player may distribute X damage among characters they control. If they do, shuffle Dagnir’s Spawn into the encounter deck.

name: Abandoned Ruin
text: Setup: Shuffle Abandoned Ruin into the Caves deck, if able. Otherwise, remove it from the game. Response: After Abandoned Ruin becomes the active location, look at 3 random undiscovered treasures and attach 1 of them to Abandoned Ruin as a guarded objective. When that treasure is free of encounters, the players claim it and attach it to an eligible character. Limit once per game for the group.

name: Master of the Hunt
text: Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 hit point. Response: After attached hero commits to the quest, choose a player to look at the top 3 cards of their deck. They put 1 of those cards on the top of their deck and put the rest on the bottom of their deck in any order.

name: Unbroken
text: Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [defense]. Action: Discard a card from your hand to heal 1 damage from attached hero. This ability may be triggered by each player once each round.

name: The Steadfast
text: Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower]. Response: After attached hero commits to the quest, if your threat is 40 or higher, place 1 progress on the current quest.

name: Dragon-slayer
text: Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [attack]. Response: After a non-unique enemy is added to the staging area, exhaust Dragon-slayer to engage that enemy. It makes an immediate attack against you.

name: The Canny Huntsman
text: Quest Action: Look at the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. Put any number of those cards on top of the encounter deck and the rest on the bottom in any order. The hero with Master of the Hunt attached gets +3 [willpower] until the end of the phase.

name: A Tale of Victories
text: Combat Action: Draw a card for each enemy engaged with you. Heal 3 damage from the hero with Unbroken attached. The next time that hero would be dealt damage this phase, cancel 3 of that damage.

name: Lay of Courage
text: Quest Response: Cancel the “when revealed” effects of a card that was just revealed from the encounter deck. Ready the hero with The Steadfast attached. Add Lay of Courage to the victory display.

name: Rhyme of the Slayer
text: Combat Action: Choose an enemy. That enemy gets –4 [attack] until the end of the phase. The hero with Dragon-slayer attached gets +4 [attack] while attacking that enemy this phase.

name: Urdug's Cunning
text: When Revealed: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. For each enemy discarded this way, each player must deal 1 damage to a character they control.
shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +2 [defense] this phase.

name: Misplaced Trust
text: Setup: Shuffle Misplaced Trust into your deck. (Do this after drawing your starting hand.) Forced: After you draw this card, attach it to a hero you control. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: “Attached character cannot have player card attachments and is immune to player card effects.”)

name: Beldis
text: Action: Spend 1 resource and mark a use in the campaign log to heal 3 damage from a character. Any player may trigger this ability. (Each player has 4 uses for the campaign.)

name: Ashen Brazier
text: If unattached, the first player claims Ashen Brazier and attaches it to a hero they control. Action: Exhaust Ashen Brazier to look at a facedown shadow card.

name: Gundabad Hunter
text: When Revealed: Choose a player that is engaged with a unique enemy, if able. Gundabad Hunter makes an immediate attack against that player.
shadow: Shadow: If attacking enemy is unique, it makes an additional attack after this one.

name: Gundabad Stalker
text: Gundabad Stalker cannot be optionally engaged except by a player who is engaged with a unique enemy.
shadow: Shadow: If attacking enemy is unique, return it to the staging area after this attack.

name: Dragon-sickness
text: When Revealed: Attach to a character with 1 or more treasures attached, then attach all unguarded treasures in play to that character. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: “Forced: After attached character exhausts, raise your threat by 1 for each treasure attached to it.”)

name: Anvil of Gundabad
text: Attach to a character. Response: After you claim or play Anvil of Gundabad, search the top 5 cards of your deck for any number of Item attachments and add them to your hand. Shuffle your deck. Action: Exhaust Anvil of Gundabad and attached character to play an Item attachment from your hand, reducing its cost by 1.

name: Axe of the Edain
text: Attach to a character. Restricted. Attached character gets +2 [attack]. Response: After you play Axe of the Edain, deal 2 damage to a non-unique enemy engaged with you.

name: Durin's Dagger
text: Attach to a character. Attached character gets +1 [attack]. You may play Durin’s Dagger from your discard pile.

name: Dwarf-Lord's Crown
text: Attach to a hero. Action: Exhaust Dwarf-Lord’s Crown to give each ally that shares a Trait with attached hero +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] until the end of the phase.

name: Glittering Lute
text: Attach to a character. Restricted. Attached character gets +2 [willpower]. Response: After you play Glittering Lute, each player may discard a card from their hand. Each player who does so reduces their threat by 2.

name: Gondolin Shield
text: Attach to a character. Restricted. Attached character gets +1 [defense] and gains sentinel. Response: Exhaust Gondolin Shield and spend 1 resource to cancel a shadow effect just triggered during an attack that attached character is defending. Then, deal the attacking enemy another shadow card.

name: Helm of Heroes
text: Attach to a character. Restricted. Attached character gets +2 [defense]. Response: After attached character takes 1 or more damage from an enemy’s attack, add 1 resource to any hero’s resource pool.

name: Jewels of Wilderland
text: Attach to a character. Attached character gets +1 [willpower]. Action: Exhaust Jewels of Wilderland and discard a card from your hand to draw a card.

name: Masterwork Bow
text: Attach to a character. Restricted. Attached character gets +1 [attack] and gains ranged. Response: After attached character attacks and defeats an enemy, place 1 progress on a location in the staging area.

name: Bilbo Baggins
text: The first player gains control of Bilbo Baggins. Bilbo Baggins cannot gain resources from player card effects. If Bilbo Baggins leaves play, the players lose the game.

name: Thorin Oakenshield
text: If you control at least 5 Dwarf characters, add 1 additional resource to Thorin Oakenshield's pool when you collect resources during the resource phase.
flavor: "I am Thorin son of Thrain son of Thror, King under the Mountain!" <cite>Thorin, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Nori
text: Response: After you play a Dwarf character from your hand, reduce your threat by 1.
flavor: "Nori, at your service." <cite>Nori, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Ori
text: If you control at least 5 Dwarf characters, draw 1 additional card at the beginning of the resource phase.
flavor: "He could write well and speedily, and often used the Elvish characters." <cite>Gimli, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Beorn
text:
Sentinel. Cannot have attachments.
Immune to player card effects.
Beorn does not exhaust to defend.
flavor:
The roar of his voice was like drums and guns; and he tossed wolves and goblins from his path like straws and feathers.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Fili
text: Response: After you play Fili from your hand during the planning phase, search your deck for Kili and put him into play under your control. Then, shuffle your deck.
flavor: "Fili is the youngest and still has the best sight" —Thorin, The Hobbit

name: Kili
text: Response: After you play Kili from your hand during the planning phase, search your deck for Fili and put him into play under your control. Then, shuffle your deck.
flavor: "Let us join the throng!" —Kili, The Hobbit

name: Bofur
text: Action: Exhaust Bofur to search the top 5 cards of your deck for 1 Weapon attachment. Add that card to your hand and shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

name: Dori
text: Response: After a hero is assigned any amount of damage, exhaust Dori to place that damage on Dori instead.

name: Gandalf
text: Gandalf does not exhaust to commit to a quest. Forced: At the end of the refresh phase, discard Gandalf from play. You may raise your threat by 2 to cancel this effect.

name: Cram
text: Attach to a hero. Action: Discard Cram to ready attached hero.

name: Spare Hood and Cloak
text: Attach to a character. Action: Exhaust Spare Hood and Cloak and exhaust attached character to ready another character. Then, attach Spare Hood and Cloak to that character.
flavor: "You will have to manage without pocket-handkerchiefs, and a good many other things, before you get to the journey's end. As for a hat, I have got a spare hood and cloak in my luggage." <cite>Dwalin, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Thrór's Map
text: Attach to a hero. Travel Action: Discard Thrór's Map to choose a location in the staging area. Make that location the active location. (If there is another active location, return it to the staging area.)
flavor: 'This was made by Thrór, your grandfather, Thorin.' he said in answer to the dwarves' excited questions. 'It is a plan of the Mountain.' <cite>Gandalf, The Hobbit</cite>

name: A Very Good Tale
text: Action: Exhaust 2 allies you control to shuffle your deck and discard the top 5 cards. Put up to 2 allies discarded by this effect into play under your control. The total cost of the allies put into play cannot exceed the total cost of the allies exhausted to pay for this effect.

name: Foe-hammer
text: Response: After a hero you control attacks and destroys an enemy, exhaust a Weapon card attached to that hero to draw 3 cards.

name: Goblin-cleaver
text: Combat Action: Exhaust a Weapon card attached to a hero you control to choose an enemy engaged with you. Deal 2 damage to that enemy. (Deal 3 damage instead if the enemy is an Orc.)
flavor: At this point Gandalf fell behind, and Thorin with him. They turned a sharp corner. 'About turn!' he shouted. 'Draw your sword, Thorin!' <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Late Adventurer
text: Quest Action: Exhaust a character you control that is not committed to the quest to commit that character to the quest.
flavor: To the end of his days Bilbo could never remember how he found himself outside, without a hat, walking-stick or any money, or anything that he usually took when he went out. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Expecting Mischief
text: Play during the quest phase, before the staging step. Action: Deal 2 damage to the first enemy revealed from the encounter deck this phase.

name: Burglar Baggins
text: Action: Bilbo Baggins gets +2 [willpower], +2 [attack], and +2 [defense] until the end of the phase. (You may spend a [baggins] resource from Bilbo Baggins' resource pool to play this card even if you do not control Bilbo Baggins.)

name: Sting
text: Attach to Bilbo Baggins. Restricted. Bilbo Baggins gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. Response: After Bilbo Baggins exhausts to defend, discard the top card of the encounter deck. Deal damage to the attacking enemy equal to the discarded card's [threat].
flavor: "I shall call you Sting." <cite>Bilbo, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Orcrist
text: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached character gets +2 [attack]. Response: After attached hero destroys an Orc enemy, add 1 resource to that hero's resource pool.
flavor: "This, Thorin, the runes name Orcrist, the Goblin-cleaver in the ancient tongue of Gondolin; it was a famous blade." <cite>Elrond, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Glamdring
text: Attach to a hero or Gandalf. Restricted. Attached character gets +2 [attack]. Response: After attached character destroys an Orc enemy, draw 1 card.
flavor: "This, Gandalf, was Glamdring, Foe-hammer that the king of Gondolin once wore." ―Elrond, The Hobbit

name: Bilbo Baggins
text: Bilbo Baggins does not count against the hero limit and cannot gain resources from non-treasure cards. The first player gains control of Bilbo Baggins. Action: Spend 1 [baggins] resource to search your deck for a treasure card and add it to your hand. If Bilbo Baggins leaves play, the players have lost the game.

name: Balin
text: Response: Pay 1 resource from Balin's resource pool to cancel a shadow effect just triggered during an attack. Then, deal the attacking enemy another shadow card. (Limit once per attack.)
flavor: "Well, it is the first time that even a mouse has crept along carefully and quietly under my very nose and not been spotted." <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Bard the Bowman
text:
Ranged.
When Bard the Bowman makes a ranged attack, the enemy he attacks gets -2 [defense] until the end of the phase.
flavor: Now he shot with a great yew bow, till all his arrows but one were spent. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Óin
text: While you control at least 5 Dwarf characters, Óin gets +1 [attack] and gains the [tactics] resource icon.
flavor: Dwarves can make fire almost anywhere out of almost anything, wind or no wind... <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Bombur
text: When counting the number of Dwarf characters you control, Bombur counts as two.
flavor: "Bombur is fattest and will do for two, he had better come alone and last." <cite>Gandalf, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Glóin
text: While you control at least 5 Dwarf characters, Glóin gains: "Response: After you play Glóin from your hand, choose a hero. Add 2 resources to that hero's resource pool."
flavor: Glóin lit several more torches, and then they all crept out, one by one... <cite> The Hobbit </cite>

name: Bifur
text: While you control at least 5 Dwarf characters, Bifur gains: "Response: After you play Bifur from your hand, draw 2 cards."
flavor: "My cousins! Bombur and Bofur <cite> we have forgotten them, they are down in the valley!" –The Hobbit</cite>

name: Dwalin
text: Sentinel. While you control at least 5 Dwarf characters, lower the cost to play Dwalin by 2.
flavor: As soon as the door was opened, he pushed inside, just as if he had been expected. –The Hobbit

name: Straight Shot
text: Action: Exhaust a Weapon attachment to choose a non-unique enemy with 0 [defense]. Discard the chosen enemy.
flavor: In it smote and vanished, barb, shaft and feather, so fierce was its flight. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Desperate Alliance
text: Action: Choose a hero you control. Until the end of the phase, give control of that hero and all resources in that hero's resource pool to another player. (Limit 1 per phase.)
flavor: "Come!" called Gandalf. "There is yet time for council." <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Ravens of the Mountain
text: Action: Exhaust a hero you control to shuffle the encounter deck and look at its top card. Place progress tokens on the current quest equal to the [threat] of the card you looked at. Then, put that card back on top of the encounter deck.
flavor: As they worked the ravens brought them constant tidings. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: To me! O my kinsfolk!
text: Action: If you control at least 1 Dwarf hero, put a Dwarf ally from your discard pile into play under your control. Put that ally on the bottom of your deck at the end of the phase.
flavor: Out leapt the King under the Mountain, and his companions followed him. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: The Lucky Number
text: Action: Choose a character in play (other than Bilbo Baggins). Add Bilbo Baggins' total [willpower], [attack], and [defense] to that character's [willpower], [attack], and [defense] respectively until the end of the phase.
flavor:
"I am the clue-finder, the web-cutter, the stinging fly. I was chosen for the lucky number."
<cite>Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Great Yew Bow
text: Attach to a hero with the printed Ranged keyword. Restricted. Combat Action: Choose an enemy in the staging area. Exhaust Great Yew Bow and attached hero to make a ranged attack against that enemy. Declare attached hero as the attacker. No other attackers can be declared for this attack.

name: Black Arrow
text: Limit 1 per deck. Attach to a hero with Ranged. Response: After attached hero declares an attack, add Black Arrow to the victory display to give attached hero +5 [attack] for this attack.
flavor: "I have saved you to the last..." <cite>Bard, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Thrór's Key
text: Attach to a hero. Response: After a location is added to the staging area, attach Thrór's Key to that location. While attached to a location, Thrór's Key gains: "Treat attached location's printed text box as blank, except for traits."
flavor: "The key that went with the map! Try it now while there is still time!" <cite>Bilbo, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Expert Treasure-hunter
text: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Response: After attached hero quests successfully, name a card type and discard the top card of your deck. If the discarded card is the named type, take it into your hand.
flavor: "Now I am a burglar indeed!" –Bilbo, The Hobbit

name: King Under the Mountain
text: Attach to a Dwarf hero. Action: Exhaust King Under the Mountain to look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 to your hand and discard the other.
flavor: "Long ago in my grandfather Thrór's time our family was driven out of the far North, and came back with all their wealth and tools to this Mountain on the map." <cite>Thorin, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Bilbo's Magic Ring
text: Attach to Bilbo Baggins. Action: Exhaust Bilbo's Magic Ring and raise your threat by 1 to gain 1 [baggins] resource. (Limit once per round.) Response: After Bilbo Baggins exhausts to defend an attack, exhaust Bilbo's Magic Ring and raise your threat by 3 to cancel all damage from this attack.

name: The Arkenstone
text: Attach to a hero. Action: Exhaust The Arkenstone and raise your threat by X to lower by X the cost of the next ally you play this phase that matches the attached hero's sphere.
flavor: "...the Heart of the Mountain; and it is also the heart of Thorin. He values it above a river of gold." <cite>Bilbo, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Mithril Shirt
text:
Attach to Bilbo Baggins.
Attached hero gets +1 [defense] and +1 hit point.
flavor: "Mr. Baggins!" he cried. "Here is the first payment of your reward! Cast off your old coat and put on this!" <cite>Thorin, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Thrór's Battle Axe
text: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +2 [attack]. Response: After attached hero attacks and destroys an enemy, deal 1 damage to another enemy engaged with you.
flavor: Royal indeed did Thorin look, clad in a coat of gold-plated rings, with a silver hafted axe... <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Thrór's Hunting Bow
text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gains Ranged.
When making a ranged attack, attached hero gets +2 [attack].
flavor: Thorin seized a bow of horn and shot an arrow at the speaker. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Thrór's Golden Cup
text: Attach to a hero. Action: Add Thrór's Golden Cup to the victory display to draw 3 cards.
flavor: ...the great golden cup of Thrór, two-handed, hammered and carven with birds and flowers whose eyes and petals were of jewels... <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Frodo Baggins
text: Response: Spend 1 [fellowship] resource and exhaust The One Ring to cancel the effect of an encounter card just revealed from the encounter deck. Shuffle that card back into the encounter deck and reveal another encounter card.
flavor: "I will take the Ring," he said, "though I do not know the way." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Sam Gamgee
text: Response: After you engage an enemy with a higher engagement cost than your threat, ready Sam Gamgee. He gets +1 [willpower] +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] until the end of the round.
flavor: "I'm going with him...and if any of those Black Riders try to stop him, they'll have Sam Gamgee to reckon with" <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Merry
text: Merry gets +1 [attack] for each Hobbit hero you control. Response: After Merry participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, ready another character that participated in that attack.
flavor: "You can trust us to stick to you through thick and thin to the bitter end" <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Pippin
text: Each enemy in play gets +1 engagement cost for each Hobbit hero you control. Response: After you engage an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat, draw a card.
flavor:
"We Hobbits ought to stick together, and we will"
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Fatty Bolger
text: Action: Exhaust Fatty Bolger to choose an enemy in the staging area and raise your threat by that enemy's [threat]. Until the end of the phase, that enemy does not contribute its [threat]. (Limit once per round.)
flavor: "I only hope that you do not need rescuing before the day is out" <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Bill the Pony
text: Cannot have attachments. Lower the cost to play Bill the Pony by 2 if you control Sam Gamgee. Each Hobbit character gets +1 hit point.
flavor: "He gave me a look as plain as Mr. Pippin could speak it: if you don't let me go with you, Sam, I'll follow on my own" <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Barliman Butterbur
text: If each hero you control has the Hobbit trait, damage from undefended attacks against you may be assigned to Barliman Butterbur.
flavor: "But spooks or no spooks, they won't get in The Prancing Pony so easy." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Farmer Maggot
text: Response: After Farmer Maggot enters play, deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you. (Deal 2 damage instead if that enemy's engagement cost is higher than your threat.)
flavor: "It is lucky for you that I know you. I was going out to set my dogs on any strangers." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Halfling Determination
text: Action: Choose a Hobbit character. That character gets +2 [willpower], +2 [attack], and +2 [defense] until the end of the phase.
flavor: "I have something to do before the end, and it lies ahead, not in the Shire. I must see it through, sir, if you understand me." <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Smoke Rings
text: Action: Reduce your threat by 1 for each Pipe you control. Each hero with a Pipe attachment gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.
flavor: ...he smoked and blew smoke-rings with the same vigour and delight...<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Take No Notice
text: Lower the cost play Take No Notice by 1 for each Hobbit or Ranger hero you control. Action: Add 5 to each enemy's engagement cost until the end of the round.
flavor: ...they made no noise that even hobbits would hear. Event the wild things in the fields and woods hardly noticed their passing. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Frodo's Intuition
text: Action: Each hero you control gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the round. Draw 1 card for each Hobbit hero you control.
flavor: "I wonder if that is Gandalf coming after us" said Frodo, but even as he said it, he had a feeling that it was not so... <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Hobbit Cloak
text: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets +2 [defense] while defending against an attack by an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat.
flavor: In their dark cloaks they were invisible as if they all had magic rings. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Dagger of Westernesse
text:
Restricted.
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if attacking an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat).
flavor:
...these blades were forged many long years ago by Men of Westernesse: they were foes of the Dark Lord...
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Hobbit Pipe
text: Attach to a Hobbit character. Limit 1 per character. Response: After your threat is reduced by an event card effect, exhaust Hobbit Pipe to draw a card.
flavor: But even the Dúnedain of Gondor allow us this credit: Hobbits first put it into pipes. Not even the Wizards first thought of that before we did. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Elf-stone
text: Attach to the active location. Attached location gets +1 quest point. Response: After attached location leaves play as an explored location, the first player puts 1 ally into play from his hand.
flavor:
"It is a beryl, an elf-stone. Whether it was set there, or let fall by chance, I cannot say, but it brings hope to me"
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Mr. Underhill
text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to the Ring-bearer. Action: Add Mr. Underhill to the victory display to choose an enemy engaged with you. Until the end of the round, that enemy cannot attack you.
flavor: "I will give you a travelling name now. When you go, go as Mr. Underhill." -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Tireless Ranger
text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [defense] and gains the Ranger trait.
flavor: "What roads would any dare to tread, what safety would there be in quiet lands, or in the homes of simple men at night, if the Dúnedain were asleep, or were all gone into the grave?" -Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Skilled Healer
text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +2 hit points and gains the Healer trait.
flavor: "Few now have the skill in healing to match such evil weapons. But I will do what I can." -Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Valiant Warrior
text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] and gains the Warrior trait.
flavor: "Three of the servants of Sauron were upon the Bridge, but they withdrew and I pursued them westward." -Glorfindel, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Noble Hero
text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower] and gains the Noble trait.
flavor: Venerable he seemed as a king crowned with many winters, and yet hale as a tried warrior in the fullness of his strength. -The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Gildor Inglorion
text: The first player gains control of Gildor Inglorion. Forced: At the end of the round, discard Gildor Inglorion. The first player may spend 1 [fellowship] resource to cancel this effect.
flavor: "We think you had best come now with us." -The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Gandalf's Delay
text: Setup: Add Gandalf's Delay to the staging area. Skip the draw cards step during the first round of the game.
flavor:
The next day Frodo became really anxious, and kept a constant look–out for Gandalf. Thursday, his birthday morning, dawned as fair and clear as it had long ago for Bilbo's great party. Still Gandalf did not appear.
–The Fellowship of the Ring

name: The Ring Draws Them
text: Surge. When Revealed: At the end of the phase, each enemy in the staging area engages the first player. If The One Ring is exhausted, this effect cannot be canceled.
flavor: "Also," he added, and his voice sank to a whisper, "the Ring draws them" –The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Weight of the Ring
text: Surge. When Revealed: Attach to the Ring-bearer. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: At the beginning of each quest phase, either exhaust The One Ring or reveal an additional encounter card this phase.")
flavor: Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo... –The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Fear of Discovery
text: Surge. When Revealed: The first player must either exhaust the Ring-bearer or reveal an additional encounter card. Shadow: Defending player raises his threat by 3.
shadow: Shadow: Defending player raises his threat by 3.

name: Eaten Alive!
text: Surge. When Revealed: The first player must deal X damage divided among heroes he controls where X is the number of players in the game. Shadow: Deal 1 damage to defending character.
shadow: Shadow: Deal 1 damage to the defending character.

name: Panicked
text: Surge. When Revealed: The first player raises his threat by 3 and passes the first player token to the next player. Shadow: Defending player exhausts a character he controls.
shadow: Shadow: Defending player exhausts a character he controls.

name: Overcome by Terror
text: Surge. When Revealed: The first player must exhaust The One Ring. If The One Ring is already exhausted, the first player must discard 2 cards at random from his hand. Shadow: Defending player discards 1 card at random from his hand.
shadow: Shadow: Defending player discards 1 card at random from his hand.

name: Frodo Baggins
text: Response: After Frodo Baggins exhausts to defend an attack, exhaust The One Ring and spend 1 [fellowship] resource to target the attacking enemy. Then, this attack deals no damage and each player raises his threat by 2.
flavor: "But there is more about you now than appears on the surface." <cite>Bilbo, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Gandalf
text: Play with the top card of your deck faceup. Once per phase, you may play the top card of your deck as if it was in your hand. When playing a card this way, Gandalf is considered to have the printed [leadership], [lore], [tactics], and [spirit] icons.
flavor: "I am a servant of the Secret Fire, wielder of the flame of Anor." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Galadriel
text: At the end of the round, discard Galadriel from play. Response: After you play Galadriel from your hand, search the top 5 cards of your deck for an attachment of cost 3 or less and put it into play. Put the remaining cards back in any order.

name: Boromir
text: Boromir gets +2 [defense] while defending against an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat. Response: After Boromir takes any amount of damage, ready him.

name: Elrond
text: At the end of the round, discard Elrond from play. Response: After Elrond enters play, choose one: heal all damage on a hero, discard a Condition attachment, or each player draws 1 card.

name: Bilbo Baggins
text: Response: After Bilbo Baggins enters play, search your deck for a Pipe attachment and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
flavor: "Elves may thrive on speech alone, and Dwarves endure great weariness, but I am an old Hobbit, and I miss my meal at noon." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Flame of Anor
text: Action: Add Flame of Anor to the victory display and discard the top card of your deck to ready an Istari character you control. That character gets +X [attack] until the end of the phase where X is the discarded card's cost.
flavor: "You cannot pass!" <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Gandalf's Staff
text: Attach to Gandalf. Restricted. Action: Exhaust Gandalf's Staff to (choose one): choose a player to draw 1 card, add 1 resource to a hero's resource pool, or discard a shadow card from a non-unique enemy.
flavor: ...he held his staff aloft, and from its tip there came a feint radiance. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Wizard Pipe
text: Attach to an Istari character. Limit 1 per character. Action: Exhaust Wizard Pipe to exchange a card in your hand with the top card of your deck.
flavor: ...there was a long silence, broken only by the soft puffs of Gandalf's pipe, as he blew white smoke-rings out of the window. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Fellowship of the Ring
text: Attach to the Ring-bearer. Each hero gets +1 [willpower]. Forced: After a character is destroyed, discard Fellowship of the Ring.
flavor:
"The Company of the Ring shall be Nine: and the Nine Walkers shall be set against the Nine Riders that are evil."
<cite>Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Sting
text: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. Response: After attached hero exhausts to defend an attack, discard the top card of the encounter deck. Deal damage to the attacking enemy equal to the discarded card's [threat].

name: Mithril Shirt
text: Attach to the Ring-bearer. Attached hero gets +1 [defense] and +1 hit point.
flavor: "I should feel happier if I knew you were wearing it. I have a fancy it would turn even the knives of the Black Riders..." -Bilbo, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Glamdring
text: Attach to a Warrior hero or Gandalf. Restricted. Attached character gets +2 [attack]. Response: After attached character destroys an Orc enemy, draw 1 card.
flavor: "...at his side was the elven-sword Glamdring, the mate of Orcrist that lay now upon the breast of Thorin under the Lonely Mountain." -The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Andúril
text: Attach to a Noble hero or Aragorn. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. Response: After an attack in which the attached hero defended resolves, exhaust Andúril to target the enemy that just attacked. Declare attached hero as an attacker against that enemy (and resolve the attack).

name: Phial of Galadriel
text: Setup: Attach to a hero in play. Action: Add Phial of Galadriel to the victory display and remove it from the campaign pool, to give each enemy engaged with you -4 [attack] until the end of the round.
flavor: "May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out." -Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Three Golden Hairs
text: Setup: Attach to a hero in play. Action: Add Three Golden Hairs to the victory display and remove it from the campaign pool, to lower each player's threat by 3. Then, each player draws 3 cards.
flavor: "...your hands shall flow with gold, and yet over you gold shall have no dominion." -Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Lórien Rope
text: Setup: Attach to a hero in play. Action: Add Lórien Rope to the victory display, and remove it from the campaign pool to give each location in the staging area -2 [threat] until the end of the phase.
flavor: "What a piece of luck you had that rope!" -Frodo, The Two Towers

name: Leaf-wrapped Lembas
text: Setup: Attach to a hero in play. Action: Add Leaf-wrapped Lembas to the victory display and remove it from the campaign pool, to ready all heroes in play.
flavor: Often in their hearts they thanked the lady of Lórien for the gift of lembas, for they could eat of it and find new strength even as they ran. -The Two Towers

name: Lust for the Ring
text: Peril. Surge. When Revealed: Attach to a non-[fellowship] hero in play. Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: After The One Ring exhausts, raise each player's threat by 1 and reduce attached hero's [willpower] to 0 until the end of the round."

name: Shadow of Fear
text: Doomed 1. Surge. When Revealed: Treat the printed text box of each character in play as blank (except for Traits) until the end of the round. Shadow: Defending character does not count its [defense].
shadow: Shadow: Defending character does not count its [defense].

name: Pursued by the Enemy
text: Doomed 1. Surge. When Revealed: Each enemy engaged with a player, and not in the staging area, makes an immediate attack. Shadow: Attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.
shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.

name: Overcome by Grief
text: Setup: Add Overcome by Grief to the staging area. Forced: After a character is destroyed, if Overcome by Grief is unattached, attach to a hero. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: After a character you control is destroyed, exhaust attached hero. Until the end of the round, attached hero cannot ready.")

name: Grievous Wound
text: Setup: Add Grievous Wound to the staging area. Forced: After a hero takes damage, if Grievous Wound is unattached, attach to that hero. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: After attached hero exhausts, deal 1 damage to it.")

name: Followed by Night
text: Peril. Surge. When Revealed: Put the topmost enemy of the encounter deck discard pile into play engaged with you.
flavor: "Quite apart from murder by night on his own account, he may put any enemy that is about on our track." –Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Ill Fate
text: Peril. Surge. When Revealed: Attach to a hero you control. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: After a character you control is destroyed, raise your threat by 2.")
flavor: "Alas! An ill fate is on me this day, and all that I do goes amiss." –Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Aragorn
text: The first player gains control of Aragorn. If Aragorn leaves play, the players lose the game. Action: Spend 2 resources from Aragorn's resource pool to ready a hero.
flavor:
"I am Aragorn son of Arathorn and am called Elessar, the Elfstone, Dunadan, the heir of Isildur Elendil’s son of Gondor."
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Théoden
text: Sentinel. Reduce the cost of the first Rohan ally you play from your hand each round by 1 (to a minimum of 0).
flavor: "Arise now, arise, Riders of Théoden!" <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Treebeard
text: Cannot have restricted attachments. Action: Deal 1 damage to Treebeard to give him +1 [willpower] and +1 [attack] until the end of the phase. (Limit 5 times per phase.)
flavor:
"I am not altogether on anybody's side, because nobody is altogether on my side..."
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Gimli
text: Sentinel. Response: After an enemy is revealed from the encounter deck, ready Gimli.
flavor:
"Give me a row of orc-necks and room to swing and all weariness will fall from me!"
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Legolas
text: Ranged. Response: After Legolas participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, draw 1 card.
flavor: "He stands not alone," said Legolas, bending his bow and fitting an arrow with hands that moved quicker than sight. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Quickbeam
text: Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. Response: After Quickbeam enters play, deal 1 damage to him to ready him.
flavor: "I am Bregalad, that is Quickbeam in your language. But it is only a nickname, of course." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Háma
text: Combat Action: Ready Háma. He gets +3 [defense] until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase, discard Háma. (Limit once per round.)
flavor: "I am the Doorward of Théoden," he said. "Háma is my name." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Arod
text: Attach to a hero or Legolas. Response: After attached character participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, exhaust Arod to place 1 progress token on any location.
flavor: "A smaller and lighter horse, but restive and fiery, was brought to Legolas. Arod was his name." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Ent Draught
text: Play only if you control at least 1 Ent character. Attach to a character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +2 hit points.
flavor: The effect of the draught began at the toes, and rose steadily through every limb, bringing refreshment and vigour as it coursed upwards, right to the tips of the hair. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Herugrim
text: Attach to a Rohan hero. Restricted. Reduce the cost to play Herugrim on Théoden by 1. Response: After attached hero is declared as an attacker, exhaust Herugrim to add attached hero's [willpower] to its [attack] for this attack.
flavor: "Here, lord, is Herugrim, your ancient blade." <cite>Háma, The Two Towers</cite>

name: Entmoot
text: Play only if you control at least 1 Ent character. Action: Search the top 5 cards of your deck for any number of Ent cards and add them to your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
flavor: "...it is a gathering of Ents - which does not often happen nowadays." <cite>Treebeard, The Two Towers</cite>

name: Helm! Helm!
text: Play only after the resolving enemy attacks step is complete. Combat Action: Exhaust and discard a Rohan ally you control to choose and discard a non-unique enemy engaged with you.
flavor: "Helm is arisen and comes back to war. Helm for Théoden King!" <cite>Riders of Rohan, The Two Towers</cite>

name: The Three Hunters
text: Play only if you control [fellowship] Aragorn. Quest Action: Choose 3 heroes committed to the quest. Ready those heroes. Until the end of the round, each of the chosen heroes gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense].
flavor: "We shall makes such a chase as shall be accounted a marvel among the Three Kindreds: Elves, Dwarves, and Men. Forth the Three Hunters!" <cite>Aragorn, The Two Towers</cite>

name: Shadowfax
text: Attach to Gandalf. Gandalf gains ranged and sentinel. Action: Exhaust Shadowfax to ready Gandalf.
flavor: "He is the chief of the Mearas, lords of horses, and not even Théoden, King of Rohan, has ever looked on a better." <cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

name: Intimidation
text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a Warrior hero. Response: After attached hero is declared as the only attacker against a non-unique enemy, exhaust Intimidation to give that enemy -2 [defense] for this attack.
flavor: "None knows what the new day shall bring him," said Aragorn. "Get you gone, ere it turn to your evil!" -Aragorn, The Two Towers

name: Hands of a Healer
text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a Healer hero. Action: Exhaust attached hero and Hands of a Healer to heal up to 3 damage from a hero.
flavor:
"Life to the dying
  In the king"s hand lying!"
  -Herb-master, The Return of the King

name: Forewarned
text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a Ranger hero. Response: After attached hero is declared as a defender against a non-unique enemy, exhaust Forewarned to discard 1 shadow card from that enemy.
flavor: "Faint and far are the feet of our enemies." -Aragorn, The Two Towers

name: Leader of Men
text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a Noble hero. Response: After attached hero quests successfully, exhaust Leader of Men to add 1 resource to attached hero's pool.
flavor: "Take this, dear lord!" said a clear voice. "It was ever at your service." -The Two Towers

name: Beyond All Hope
text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], +1 [defense] and cannot have treachery card attachments.
flavor: "Beyond all hope you return to us in our need!" -Aragorn, The Two Towers

name: Palantír of Orthanc
text: Attach to [fellowship] Aragorn. Quest Action: Exhaust Aragorn and Palantír of Orthanc to discard the top card of the encounter deck. If Aragorn's [willpower] is greater than the discarded card's [threat], you may add Palantír of Orthanc to the victory display and remove it from the campaign pool to choose a player. That player reveals 1 fewer encounter card this phase (to a minimum of 0).

name: Poisoned Counsels
text: Poisoned Counsels functions like a player card. Forced: After you draw this card, discard all other cards in your hand.
flavor: "And ever Wormtongue's whispering was in your ears, poisoning your thought, chilling your heart, weakening your limbs..." –Gandalf, The Two Towers

name: Saruman's Voice
text: Peril. Doomed 2. When Revealed: Remove a hero from the quest and attach Saruman's Voice to that hero. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: When attached hero commits to the quest, is declared as an attacker or defender, or triggers its ability, its controller must discard 1 card from his hand.")

name: Frodo Baggins
text: Action: Spend 1 [fellowship] resource and exhaust The One Ring to give Frodo Baggins +2 [willpower] and +2 [attack] until the end of the round.
flavor: "It's my doom, I think, to go to that Shadow yonder, so that a way will be found." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Faramir
text: Ranged. Response: After you engage an enemy, ready an ally you control. (Limit once per phase.)
flavor: "That will be the Captain: he can master both beasts and men" <cite>Beregond, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Damrod
text: Reduce the cost of the first Trap card you play each round by 1 (to a minimum of 0). Response: After a Trap card you control is attached to an enemy, draw 1 card.
flavor: "See! Some of the Southrons have broken from the trap and are flying from the road." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Anborn
text: Response: After an enemy is added to the staging area, exhaust Anborn to give that enemy +5 engagement cost until the end of the round. Then, deal 1 damage to that enemy.
flavor: "Now I have him at arrow-point." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Mablung
text: Response: After Mablung enters play, choose an enemy to get +5 engagement cost until the end of the round. Then, you may engage that enemy, or return it to the staging area.
flavor: "But still we will not sit idle and let Him do all as He would." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Skinbark
text: Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. While Skinbark is attacking alone against an Orc enemy, that enemy does not count its [defense].
flavor: "He was wounded by the Orcs, and many of his folk and his tree-herds have been murdered and destroyed." <cite>Treebeard, The Two Towers</cite>

name: Gamling
text: Response: After a Rohan ally you control is discarded from play, exhaust Gamling to return that ally to your hand.
flavor: "...we have a thousand fit to fight on foot," said Gamling, an old man, the leader of those that watched the Dike. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Staff of Lebethron
text: Attach to a Gondor or Hobbit hero. Restricted. Response: After attached hero exhausts to defend an attack from an enemy with engagement cost higher than your threat, exhaust Staff of Lebethron to discard a shadow card from that enemy.
flavor: "They are made of the fair tree lebethron, beloved of the woodwrights of Gondor..." <cite>Faramir, The Two Towers</cite>

name: Ambush
text: Play Ambush into the staging area unattached. If unattached, attach Ambush to the next eligible enemy that enters the staging area. Combat Action: The engaged player discards Ambush to declare an attack against the attached enemy.
flavor: "But we have a new errand on this journey: we come to ambush the Men of Harad." <cite>Mablung, The Two Towers</cite>

name: Snowmane
text: Attach to a Rohan hero. Restricted. If attached hero is Theoden, Snowmane loses the restricted keyword. Response: After attached hero quests successfully, ready attached hero.
flavor: Suddenly the king cried to Snowmane and the horse sprang away. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Taste it Again!
text: Response: After a hero you control defends an attack made by an enemy with engagement cost higher than your threat, ready that hero. Until the end of the phase, that hero gets +2 [attack] while attacking that enemy.
flavor: "We're going on; but we'll settle with you first. Come on, and taste it again!" <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Two Towers</cite>

name: In the Shadows
text: Lower the cost to play In the Shadows by 1 for each Hobbit or Ranger hero you control. Combat Action: Each enemy engaged with you with engagement cost higher than your threat gets -1 [attack] and -1 [defense] until the end of the phase.
flavor: He could see them stealing up the slopes, singly or in long files, keeping always to the shade of grove or thicket... <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Speak Your Promise!
text: Action: Ready the Ring-bearer to choose an enemy engaged with you. If the Ring-bearer's [willpower] is greater than that enemy’s [threat], lower that enemy's [attack] and [defense] by the difference until the end of the phase.
flavor: For a moment it appeared to Sam that his master had grown and Gollum had shrunk... <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Brace of Coneys
text: Play only if you control the Ring-bearer. Planning Action: Add Brace of Coneys to the victory display to (choose 2): heal up to 2 damage from a hero, add 2 resources to a hero's pool, choose a player to draw 2 cards, or reduce a player's threat by 2.
