flavor: "'Sméagol always helps,' he said. 'He has brought rabbits, nice rabbits.'" -Gollum, The Two Towers

name: The Searching Eye
text: The Searching Eye functions like a player card. Forced: After you draw this card, either exhaust each hero you control, or reveal the top card of the encounter deck.
flavor: ...that horrible growing sense of a hostile will that strove with great power to pierce all shadows of cloud, and earth, and flesh... -The Two Towers

name: A Heavy Burden
text: Setup: Attach to the Ring-bearer. Forced: At the end of the planning phase, either raise each player's threat by 1, or exhaust the Ring-bearer.
flavor: "It's heavy on me, Sam lad, very heavy. I wonder how far I can carry it?" -Frodo Baggins, The Two Towers

name: Aragorn
text: The first player gains control of Aragorn. If Aragorn leaves play,the players lose the game. While Aragorn has an Artifact attached, he gains sentinel and does not exhaust to quest.
flavor:
"I have no help to send, therefore I must go myself..."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Éowyn
text: Setup: Reduce your threat by 3. Action: Raise your threat by 3 to ready Éowyn. She gets +9 [attack] until the end of the phase. (Limit once per game for the group.)
flavor:
"But no living man am I! You look upon a woman. Éowyn I am, Éomund's daughter."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Beregond
text: Sentinel. Response: After Beregond defends an attack and takes no damage, reduce the defending player's threat by 1. (Limit once per round.)
flavor:
"The Lord does not permit those who wear the black and silver to leave their post for any cause..."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Grimbold
text: Combat Action: Discard Grimbold to choose an enemy engaged with a player. That enemy cannot attack that player this phase.
flavor:
Grimbold's men turned aside and passed round to a great gap in the wall further eastward.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Prince Imrahil
text: While there is a hero in your discard pile, Prince Imrahil loses the ally card type and gains the hero card type.
flavor:
"We must gather all of the strength that we can find."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Halbarad
text:
Reduce the cost to play Halbarad by 1 for each enemy engaged with you.
Each enemy engaged with you gets +10 engagement cost.
flavor:
"Halbarad Dúnadan, Ranger of the North I am..."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Ghân-buri-Ghân
text: X is the [threat] of the active location. Travel Action: Discard Ghân-buri-Ghân to travel to a location without resolving its Travel effect.
flavor:
"Ghân-buri-Ghân will not lead you into trap."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Sterner than Steel
text: Response: Exhaust a Weapon or Armor card attached to the defending character to cancel a shadow effect just triggered during combat.
flavor:
"Do what you will; but I will hinder it, if I may."
<cite>Éowyn, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Desperate Defense
text: Response: After a sentinel character is declared as a defender, it gets +2 [defense] for this attack. If this attack deals no damage, ready the defending character.
flavor: ...but alone in the porch upon the topmost step stood Beregond, clad in the black and silver of the Guard; and he held the door against them. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Golden Shield
text: Attach to a Rohan hero. Restricted. Response: After attached hero is declared as a defender, exhaust Golden Shield to add attached hero's [willpower] to it's [defense] for this attack.
flavor: His golden shield was uncovered, and lo! it shone like an image of the Sun... <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Livery of the Tower
text: Attach to a Gondor hero. Restricted. Response: Spend X resources from attached hero's pool to cancel X damage just dealt to attached hero.
flavor:
This was the livery of the heirs of Elendil, and none wore it now in all Gondor, save the Guards of the Citadel...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Roheryn
text: Attach to a Dúnedain hero. If the attached hero is Aragorn, he gains a [tactics] icon. Response: After you optionally engage an enemy, exhaust Roheryn and attached hero to declare attached hero as an attacker (and resolve its attack) against that enemy.
flavor:
"Aragorn's own horse that they had brought from the North; Roheryn was his name."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Banner of Elendil
text:
Attach to Aragorn.
While Aragorn is commited to the quest, each other questing character you control gets +1 [willpower].
While Aragorn is attacking, each other attacking character you control gets +1 [attack].
flavor:
Seven stars were about it, and a high crown above it, the signs of Elendil that no lord had borne for years beyond count.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Esquire of Rohan
text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains the Rohan trait. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] while attacking with another Rohan character.
flavor: "Rise now, Meriadoc, esquire of Rohan of the household of Meduseld!" -Théoden, The Return of the King

name: Esquire of Gondor
text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains the Gondor trait. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower] while committed to the quest with another Gondor character.
flavor: "Here do I swear fealty and service to Gondor, and to the Lord and Steward of the realm..." -Pippin, The Return of the King

name: Overcome by Fear
text: Setup: Attach to your threat dial. Limit 1 per threat dial. Your threat cannot be reduced. Forced: At the end of the round, raise your threat by 1. Then you may spend 1 [fellowship] resource to detach Overcome by Fear and set it aside, out of play.
encounter_set: The Passing of the Grey Company

name: Wraith on Wings
text: Setup: Add Wraith on Wings to the staging area. Cannot have non-Morgul attachments. Wraith on Wings gets +1 [threat] and -1 enagement cost for each resource on it. Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, place 1 resource on Wraith on Wings (Limit 5 resources.)
encounter_set: The Battle of the Pelennor Fields

name: Army of the Dead
text: Immune to player card effects. The first player gains control of Army of the Dead. Setup: The first player takes control of Army of the Dead. If Army of the Dead leaves play, remove it from the game.
flavor: "Now come! By the Black Stone I call you!" -Aragorn, The Return of the King

name: Frodo Baggins
text: Planning Action: Exhaust The One Ring to add 1 resource to a hero's pool.
flavor: "I must carry the burden to the end." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Aragorn
text: Sentinel. The first player gains control of Aragorn. Action: Spend 1 resource from Aragorn's pool to ready him. (Limit once per phase.) If Aragorn leaves play, the players lose the game.
flavor: "As I have begun, so I will go on.." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Éomer
text: Response: After Éomer commits to the quest, spend 1 resource from his resource pool to immediately declare him as an attacker (and resolve his attack) against an enemy in the staging area.
flavor: ...he was young, and he was king; the lord of a fell people. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Tom Cotton
text: While you are engaged with an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat, the first Hobbit ally you play each round does not require a resource match. Response: After a Hobbit ally enters play, it gets +2 [attack] until the end of the round.

name: Rosie Cotton
text: Action: Exhaust Rosie Cotton to choose a Hobbit hero and an attribute ([willpower], [attack], [defense]). Add Rosie Cotton's [willpower] to that hero's chosen attribute until the end of the phase. (Limit once per phase.)
flavor: "…take care of yourself, and come straight back as soon as you have settled the ruffians!" <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Elfhelm
text: Action: Spend 1 resource from a Rohan hero's resource pool to put Elfhelm into play from your hand under your control. At the end of the phase, discard Elfhelm if he is still in play.
flavor: "...my lord sends word that we must set ourselves in readiness; orders may come for a sudden move." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Elladan
text: While Elrohir is in play, Elladan gets +2 [attack]. After you optionally engage an Orc enemy, ready Elladan.
flavor: ...they rode often far afield with the Rangers of the North, forgetting never their mother's torment in the dens of the Orcs. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Elrohir
text: While Elladan is in play, Elrohir gets +2 [defense]. After you optionally engage an Orc enemy, ready Elrohir.
flavor: "From the North we came with this purpose, and from Elrond our father we brought this very counsel." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Orc Disguise
text: Attach to the Ring-bearer. Limit one per hero. While an Orc is making an enagement check with you, it gets +5 engagement cost. Response: After an Orc engages you, discard Orc Disguise. . Until the end of the round, that enemy cannot attack you.
flavor: "Well, there you are, Mr. Frodo. A perfect little orc…" <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Captains of the West
text: Quest Action: Until the end of the phase, each Noble hero gets +1 [willpower] and does not exhaust to commit to the quest.
flavor: "...there are names among us that are worth more than a thousand mail-clad knights apiece." <cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Gúthwinë
text: Attach to a Rohan hero. Restricted. Response: After attached hero is declared as an attacker, exhaust Gúthwinë to give that hero +2 [attack] for this attack. If this attack destroys an enemy, return a Rohan ally from your discard pile to your hand.
flavor: "Gúthwinë!" cried Éomer. "Gúthwinë for the Mark!" <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Friend of Friends
text: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Limit 2 copies of Friend of Friends in play. While another hero has Friend of Friends attached, attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], +1 [defense] and +1 hit point.
flavor: "Come, Mr. Frodo!" he cried, "I can't carry it for you, but I can carry you and it as well." <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Raise the Shire
text: Response: After you engage an enemy, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Hobbit ally and put it into play (search you entire deck instead if that enemy's engagement cost is higher than your threat). Shuffle your deck. At the end of the round, if that ally is still in play, return it to your hand.
flavor: …come on now, lads! Bywater is up! We must be in it!" <cite>Tom Cotton, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Gwaihir
text: Ranged. Sentinel. When Revealed: The first player must choose: either take control of Gwaihir, or spend 1 [fellowship] resource and discard Gwaihir to discard a non-unique enemy in the staging area. Shadow: This attack deals no damage.
shadow: Shadow: This attack deals no damage.

name: Old Bogey-stories
text: Setup: The first player attaches Old Bogey-stories to a hero in play. Action: Add Old Bogey-stories to the victory display to shuffle your hand of at least 6 cards into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.
flavor: "If you mean the old bogey-stories Fatty's nurses used to tell him, about goblins and wolves and things of that sort, I should say no." -Merry, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Ho! Tom Bombadil!
text: Setup: The first player adds this card to his hand. Response: Add this card to the victory display and remove it from the campaign pool to cancel the "when revealed" effects of an encounter card just revealed from the encounter deck.
flavor:
By fire, sun and moon, harken now and hear us!
 Come, Tom Bombadil, for our need is near us!
 -Frodo, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Gimli
text: Sentinel. Response: After Gimli is declared as a defender, spend 1 resource from his pool to ready another hero. If that hero is Legolas, he gets +1[attack] until the end of the phase. (Limit once per phase.)
flavor:
"Faithless is he that says farewell when the road darkens…"
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Legolas
text: Ranged. Response: After Legolas commits to a quest, discard a card from your hand to ready another hero. If that hero is Gimli, he gets +1[willpower] until the end of the phase. (Limit once per phase.)
flavor:
"I go to find the Sun!"
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Greenwood Archer
text: Ranged. Response: After Greenwood Archer enters play, ready a hero.
flavor:
They dwelt most often by the edges of the woods, from which they could escape at times to hunt...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Erebor Guard
text: Sentinel. Response: When you play Erebor Guard from you hand, discard the top 2 cards of your deck to reduce its cost by 2.
flavor:
...the fortress of the dwarves could not be taken by surprise.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Halfling Bounder
text: While there is a side quest in the victory display, Halfling Bounder gains: "Response: Discard Halfling Bounder to cancel the 'when revealed' effects of an encounter card that was just revealed from the encounter deck."
flavor:
"The Bounders have never been so busy before."
<cite>Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Vigilant Dúnadan
text: While there is a side quest in the victory display, Vigilant Dúnadan does not exhaust to defend.
flavor:
"I don't think we've rightly understood till now what they did for us."
<cite>Barliman Butterbur, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Unlikely Friendship
text: Play only if you control a unique character with the Silvan trait and another unique character with the Dwarf trait. Action: Draw 1 card and add 1 resource to the resource pool of a hero you control.
flavor:
...folk that saw them pass marvelled to see such companions…
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Well Warned
text: Play only if you control a unique character with the Noble trait and another unique character with the Scout trait. Response: After a player engages an enemy, reduce his threat by X, where X is that enemy's printed [threat].
flavor:
...the Captains of the West were well warned by their scouts...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Dour Handed
text: Action: Deal X damage to an enemy engaged with you. X is the number of side quests in the victory display.
flavor:
...the tides of fate had turned against them and their doom was at hand.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Dwarven Shield
text: Attach to a Dwarf hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1[defense]. Response: After attached hero takes damage from an enemy attack, exhaust Dwarven Shield to add 1 resource to attached hero's pool.
flavor:
...each of them had also a short broad sword at his side and a round shield slung at his back.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Mirkwood Long-knife
text: Attach to a Silvan hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1[willpower] and +1[attack].
flavor:
Legolas had a bow and a quiver, and at his belt a long white knife.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: The Road Goes Ever On
text: Attach to a quest card in play. Response: When attached quest is defeated, the first player chooses a player. That player searches his deck for a side quest, adds it to his hand, and shuffles his deck.
flavor:
"Now far ahead the Road has gone,
And I must follow, if I can..."
<cite>Frodo Baggins, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: The Storm Comes
text:
Limit 1 copy of The Storm Comes in the victory display.
While this quest is in the victory display, the first ally played by each player each round does not require a resource match.
flavor:
"For behold! The storm comes, and now all friends should gather together, lest each singly be destroyed."
<cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Kahliel
text: You may use resources from Kahliel's resource pool to pay for Harad ally cards of any sphere. Action: Discard a Harad ally card from your hand to ready a Harad character in play. (Limit once per phase.)
flavor:
...the Southrons were bold men and grim...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Andrath Guardsman
text: Response: After you play Andrath Guardsman from your hand, choose a non-unique enemy engaged with you. That enemy cannot attack you this round.
flavor:
They forgot or ignored what little they had known of the Guardians, and of the labours of those that made possible the long peace of the Shire.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Prepare for Battle
text:
Limit 1 copy of Prepare for Battle in the victory display.
While this quest is in the victory display, the first player draws an additional card during the resource phase.
flavor:
"Soon there will be battle on the fields. A sortie must be made ready."
<cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Yazan
text: Ranged. Response: After Yazan is declared as an attacker, deal 1 damage to a non-unique enemy in play. (Limit once per phase.)
flavor:
...he and his knights still held themselves like lords in whom the race of Númenor ran true.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Wait no Longer
text: Response: At the beginning of the quest phase, search the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy and put it into play engaged with you. Then, reveal one less encounter card this phase (to a minimum of 0). Shuffle the encounter deck.
flavor:
"We must press our Enemy, and no longer wait upon him for the move."
<cite>Aragorn, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Jubayr
text: Sentinel. Response: After Jubayr exhausts to defend an attack, discard 1 facedown shadow card from a non-unique enemy. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Dwarf Pipe
text: Attach to a Dwarf character. Limit 1 per character. Response: After a card is discarded from your deck, exhaust Dwarf Pipe to place that card on the bottom of your deck.
flavor:
He held up a small pipe with a wide flattened bowl...
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Firyal
text: Response: After Firyal commits to the quest, look at the top card of the encounter deck. Then, you may discard the looked at card.

name: Coney in a Trap
text: Play only if you control a unique character with the Ranger trait and another unique character with the Warrior trait. Response: After you engage an enemy, that enemy cannot attack you until the end of the round.

name: Kahliel's Headdress
text: Attach to Kahliel. Restricted. Each Harad character gets +1[willpower]. Refresh Action: Exhaust Kahliel's Headdress to shuffle the topmost Harad ally in your discard pile into your deck.

name: Thurindir
text: Thurindir gets +1 [willpower] for each side quest in the victory display. Setup: Search your deck for a side quest and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
flavor: “He is one of the wandering folk - Rangers we call them.” -Barliman Butterbur, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Kahliel's Tribesman
text: Action: Exhaust Kahliel's Tribesman to choose another Harad character. That character gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] until the end of the phase.
flavor: But the Haradrim, being now driven to the brink, turned at bay, and they were fierce in despair... -The Return of the King

name: Steed of the North
text: Attach to a Dunedain or Ranger hero. Restricted. Response: After you engage an enemy, exhaust Steed of the North to ready attached hero.
flavor: Their horses were strong and of proud bearing, but rough-haired... -The Return of the King

name: Mighty Warrior
text: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gains the Warrior trait. Response: After you play Mighty Warrior from your hand, draw a card.
flavor: Gimli hewed the legs from another that had sprung up on Balin’s tomb. -The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Proud Hunters
text: Play only if you control a unique character with the Noble trait and another unique character with the Ranger trait. Response: After a hero you control participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, add X resources to that hero’s pool. X is the just destroyed enemy’s printed [threat].

name: Dunedain Pathfinder
text: Forced: After this ally enters play, search the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for a non-unique location and add it to the staging area. If no location enters play by this effect, discard Dunedain Pathfinder. Shuffle the encounter deck.

name: Backtrack
text: Play only if the main quest has no keywords. Action: Remove X progress from the main quest to place X progress on a location in the staging area.
flavor: “Well,” said Boromir, “when heads are at a loss bodies must serve...” -The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Eryn Galen Settler
text: Response: When the active location leaves play as an explored location, discard Eryn Galen Settler to discard a location in the staging with the same title as the just explored location.

name: Explore Secret Ways
text:
Limit 1 copy of Explore Secret Ways in the victory display.
While this side quest is in the victory display, each location in the staging area with the same title as the active location does not contribute its [threat] to the total [threat] of the staging area.
flavor: “I myself dared to pass the doors of the Necromancer in Dol Guldur, and secretly explored his ways...” -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Steward of Orthanc
text: Response: When you play an event, give it Doomed 1 to draw a card. You cannot trigger this ability if you have already triggered the ability of a Steward of Orthanc this round.
flavor: “...the power of Orthanc cannot be lightly thrown aside...” -Saruman, The Two Towers

name: Hirgon
text: Response: After Hirgon quests successfully, play a [tactics] ally from your hand, reducing its cost by 1 (to a minimum of 1). Then, you may raise your threat by 1 to give that ally +1 [attack] and +1 [defense]  until the end of the round.
flavor: "Hirgon I am, errand-rider of Denethor, who bring you this token of war." -The Return of the King

name: Haradrim Spear
text: Restricted. Attach to a Haradrim character. Attached character gets +1 [attack]. Response: After attached character is declared as an attacker, it gets +3 [attack] for this attack. After this attack resolves, discard Haradrim Spear.

name: Hunting Party
text: Play only if you control a unique character with the Warrior trait and another unique character with the Scout trait. Response: After the players have committed characters to the quest, discard a non-unique enemy in the staging area. Then, reveal an encounter card.

name: The Red Arrow
text: Limit 1 per deck. Attach to a Gondor hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower]. Valour Response: After attached hero quests successfully, add The Red Arrow to the victory display to search the top 5 cards of your deck for an ally and put it into play.
flavor: "The Red Arrow has not been seen in the Mark in all my years!" -Théoden, The Return of the King

name: Keep Watch
text:
Limit 1 copy of Keep Watch in the victory display.
While Keep Watch is in the victory display, each non-unique enemy engaged with a player gets -1 [attack].
flavor: "I called for the help of the Dúnedain, and their watch was doubled..." -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Rider of Rohan
text: While a side quest is in the victory display, Rider of Rohan does not exaust to quest.
flavor: "Who are you, and what are you doing in this land?" said the Rider, using the Common Speech of the West… -The Two Towers

name: Fireside Song
text: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower] for each Song attached to it.
flavor:
"I sit beside the fire and think
of how the world will be
when winter comes without a spring
that I shall ever see." -Bilbo Baggins, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Dunedain Lookout
text: Response: Discard Dúnedain Lookout to cancel the 'When Revealed' effects of an enemy just revealed from the encounter deck.
flavor: "Travellers scowl at us, and countrymen gives us scornful names." -Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Doughty Ranger
text: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gains the Ranger trait. Response: After you play Doughty Ranger from your hand, draw a card.
flavor: ...he went forth clad only in rusty green and brown, as a Ranger of the wilderness. -The Fellowship of the Ring

name: The Free Peoples
text: Play only if the characters you control have a total of at least 9 different Traits between them. Action: Ready each character in play. Until the end of the phase, each character you control gets +1 [willpower].
flavor: "For the rest, they shall represent the other Free Peoples of the World: Elves, Dwarves and Men." -Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Fastred
text: Response: After Fastred defends an enemy attack, return that enemy to the staging area to reduce your threat by 2. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Song of Hope
text: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Action: Spend 1 resource from attached hero’s pool to give attached hero +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase. (Limit 3 times per phase.)

name: Burst into Song
text: Action: Ready each hero with a Song attachment.

name: Defender of Cair Andros
text: Defender of Cair Andros gets +X [Defense], where X is the tens digit of your threat. (Limit +4 [Defense].) Valour Response: After Defender of Cair Andros is declared as a defender, deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy.

name: Oath of Eorl
text: Play only if you control a unique character with the Rohan trait and another unique character with the Gondor trait. Response: At the beginning of the combat phase, you resolve the step in which you attack enemies before resolving enemy attacks this phase. (Each other player resolves the combat phase as normal after you resolve your attacks.)

name: Fearless Scout
text: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gains the Scout trait. Response: After you play Fearless Scout from your hand, draw a card.

name: Rally the West
text: Limit 1 copy of Rally the West in the victory display. While this side quest is in the victory display, each hero gets +1 [willpower].
flavor: “Foes and fire are before you, and your homes far behind. Yet, though you fight upon an alien field, the glory that you reap there shall be your own forever.” -Theoden, The Return of the King

name: Dúnedain Pipe
text: Attach to a Dúnedain character. Limit 1 per character. Action: Exhaust Dúnedain Pipe and place a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck to draw a card.

name: Old Toby
text: Action: Draw 1 card for each Pipe you control. Heal 1 damage from each hero with a Pipe attachment.

name: Southron Refugee
text: Action: Exhaust Southron Refugee to reduce the cost of the next Harad ally you play this phase by 1.

name: Folco Boffin
text: Folco Boffin gets -1 threat cost for each Hobbit hero you control. Action: Discard Folco Boffin to reduce your threat by 7. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: ...he had a good many friends, especially among the younger Hobbits (mostly descendants of the Old Took)... -The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Knight of Dale
text: Action: Spend 1 [leadership] resource to ready Knight of Dale. (Limit once per round.) Valour Action: Ready Knight of Dale. (Limit once per round.)
flavor: By that time all the bells were ringing in Dale and the warriors were arming. -The Hobbit

name: Diligent Noble
text: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gains the Noble trait. Response: After you play Diligent Noble from your hand, draw a card.
flavor: "The wise will stay here and hope to rebuild our town, and enjoy in times its peace and riches." -The Master, The Hobbit

name: Riddermark Knight
text: Response: After Riddermark Knight is declared as an attacker, it gets +2 [attack] for this attack. At the end of this attack, discard Riddermark Knight.
flavor: After him thundered the knights of his house... -The Return of the King

name: Fierce Defense
text: Combat Action: Deal 3 damage to a non-unique enemy engaged with you. Valour Action: Discard a non-unique enemy engaged with you.
flavor: When thirteen had fallen the rest fled shrieking, leaving the defenders unharmed, except for Sam who had a scratch along the scalp. -The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Eregion Survivor
text: While you have no cards in your hand, Eregion Survivor gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense].
flavor: "Much evil must befall a country before it wholly forgets the Elves, if once they dwelt there." -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Heirs of Earendil
text: Play only if you control a unique character with the Noldor trait and another unique character with the Dúnedain trait. Action: Choose a non-unique location in the staging area and raise your threat by X to discard it. X is the chosen location's printed quest points.

name: Leaflock
text: Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. Leaflock gets +1 [willpower] for each damaged Ent character you control. (Limit +4 [willpower].)
flavor: "Leaflock has grown sleepy, almost tree-ish, you might say…" Treebeard, The Two Towers

name: Legacy Blade
text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gets +1 [attack] for each side quest in the victory display. (Limit +3 [attack].)
flavor: … glad would he have been to know its fate who wrought it slowly long ago in the North-kingdom when the Dúnedain were young… -The Return of the King

name: Open the Armory
text: Action: Search the top 10 cards of your deck for a Weapon or Armor attachment and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. Valour Action: Search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Weapon or Armor attachment and put it into play. Shuffle your deck.

name: Quickbeam
text: Cannot have restricted attachments. Action: Deal 2 damage to Quickbeam to ready him. (Limit once per phase.)
flavor: "...he can move like a wind when he is roused." -Pippin, The Two Towers

name: Halfast Gamgee
text: Reduce the cost to play Halfast Gamgee by 1 for each side quest in the victory display. Response: After Halfast Gamgee enters play, add 1 resource to a hero's resource pool.
flavor: "He works for Mr. Boffin at Overhill and goes up to the Northfarthing for the hunting." -Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Bulwark of the West
text: Action: Discard an ally you control to choose and discard a Condition attachment.
flavor: "By our valour the wildfolk of the East are still restrained, and the terror of Morgul kept at bay; and thus alone are peace and freedom maintained in the lads behind us…" -Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Beorning Guardian
text: Response: After Beorning Guardian participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, discard Beorning Guardian to place X progress on a location, where X is the destroyed enemy's printed [threat].
flavor: "...if it were not for the Beornings, the passage from Dale to Rivendell would long ago have become impossible." -Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Followed
text:
Play into your play area unattached. 
While unattached, attach to the next eligible enemy that engages you. 

While attached enemy is engaged with you, reduce the total [threat] in the staging area by X, where X is attached enemy's printed [threat].

name: Flight to the Sea
text: Play only if you control a Noldor or Silvan hero. Planning Action: Shuffle a set aside Wind from the Sea into the encounter deck. Then, remove Flight to the Sea from the game.
flavor: "...they may pass to the Sea unhindered and leave the Middle-earth forever." -Haldir, The Two Towers

name: Emyn Arnen Ranger
text: Response: After Emyn Arnen Ranger commits to the quest, choose an enemy with a Trap attachment. Until the end of the phase, Emyn Arnen Ranger gets +X [willpower], where X is the chosen enemy's printed [threat].

name: The Dam Bursts
text: Play only if you control a unique character with the Ent trait and another unique character with the Hobbit trait. Action: Ready each damaged Ent character you control.

name: Magic Ring
text: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero and 1 per deck. Action: Exhaust Magic Ring and raise your threat by 1 to (choose 1): heal 1 damage from attached hero, add 1 resource to attached hero's pool, or ready attached hero.
flavor: "In Eregion long ago many Elven-rings were made, magic rings as you call them, and they were, of course, of various kinds..." -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Wind from the Sea
text: Encounter. When Revealed: Ready each hero committed to the quest and remove Wind from the Sea from the game. Shadow: Ready the defending character

name: Brand son of Bain
text: Each Dale character you control with a player attachment gets +1 [willpower]. Response: After you play an attachment on a Dale character without an attachment, draw a card.
flavor:
"He is a strong king, and his realm now reaches south and east of Esgaroth."
<cite>Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Bard son of Brand
text: While playing an Item attachment, Bard son of Brand is considered to have the printed [leadership], [lore], and [tactics] icons. Response: When a character leaves play, return each attachment attached to that character to its owner's hand. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Redwater Sentry
text: Reduce the cost to play Armor attachments on Redwater Sentry by 1. Redwater Sentry gets +1 [defense] and gains Sentinel while it has an Armor attachment.

name: North Realm Lookout
text: North Realm Lookout gets +1 [willpower] and does not exhaust to quest while it has an Item attachment
flavor:
There were people on the look-out on the banks.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Warrior of Dale
text: Reduce the cost to play Weapon attachments on Warrior of Dale by 1. Warrior of Dale gets +1 [attack] and gains ranged while it has a Weapon attachment.

name: Long Lake Trader
text: Action: Exhaust Long Lake Trader to move an Item attachment from a character you control to another eligible character.
flavor:
"Nowhere are there any men so friendly to us as the Men of Dale"
<cite>Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Hauberk of Mail
text: Attach to a Dale or Warrior character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +1 [defense] (and +1 hit point if attached character has the sentinel keyword).
flavor:
Each one of his folk was clad in a hauberk of steel mail that hung to his knees…
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: King of Dale
text: Attach to a Dale or Esgaroth hero. Planning Action: Exhaust King of Dale to reduce the cost of the next Dale ally you play this phase by 1 for each different player attachment on attached hero. That ally does not require a resource match.
flavor:
Then Bard II, Brand's son, became King in Dale...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Bow of Yew
text: Attach to a Dale or Warrior character. Restricted. Response: After attached character is declared as an attacker, exhaust Bow of Yew to deal 1 damage to the defending enemy.
flavor:
"They would shoot at us with their great bows of yew…"
<cite>The Lord of the Eagles, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Map of Rhovanion
text: Attach to a Dale or Scout character. Limit 1 per character. Response: After attached character commits to the quest, place 1 progress on the active location.
flavor:
"You are come to the very edge of the Wild..."
<cite>Gandalf, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Necklace of Girion
text:
Guarded (enemy or location).
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gets +2 [willpower] and collects an additional resource during the resource phase.
flavor:
...the necklace of Girion, Lord of Dale, made of five hundred emeralds green as grass, which he gave for the arming of his eldest son…
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Traffic from Dale
text: Planning Action: Choose a Dale hero you control. Add 1 resource to its pool for each character you control with a player attachment. You can only play 1 copy of Traffic from Dale each round.
flavor:
The talk was all of the trade that came and went on the waterways and the growth of the traffic on the river...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: To Arms!
text: Action: Choose an ally with a player attachment. Ready that ally.
flavor:
...the grim-voiced fellow ran hotfoot to the Master. “The dragon is coming or I am a fool!” he cried. “Cut the bridges! To arms! To arms!”
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Valour of the North
text: Response: After a character is declared as an attacker or defender against an enemy with an attachment, that character gets +3 [attack] and +3 [defense] until the end of this attack.
flavor: "Dwarf-mail may be good, but they will soon be hard put to it." <cite>Bard the Bowman, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Bartering
text: Planning Action: Choose a ready player attachment on a character you control. Return that attachment to its owner’s hand to reduce the cost of the next attachment played this phase by X, where is the chosen attachment’s cost.

name: Grimbeorn the Old
text: Sentinel. Response: After Grimbeorn the Old defends an attack, spend 1 resource from his pool to declare him as an attacker against that enemy (and resolve his attack). The defending enemy gets -2 [defense] for this attack.

name: Guardian of Esgaroth
text: Guardian of Esgaroth gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], +1 [defense], and +1 hit point for each different player card attachment it has. (Limit +3 to each.)
flavor: The men of the lake-town Esgaroth were mostly indoors, for the breeze was from the black East and chill, but a few were walking on the quays, and watching… <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Squire's Helm
text:
Attach to an ally. Restricted.
Limit 1 per ally. 
Attached ally gets +2 hit points.
flavor:
“There are no great weapon-hoards here, lord,” answered Éomer. “Maybe a light helm might be found to fit him...”
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Beorning Skin-changer
text: Combat Action: Choose a Beorning ally with printed cost 3 or more in your hand or discard pile. Discard Beorning Skin-changer to put that ally into play.
flavor:
"...sometimes he is a huge black bear, sometimes he is a great strong black-haired man with huge arms and a great beard."
<cite>Gandalf, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Beorn's Rage
text: Response: After a Beorning character is declared as an attacker or defender against an enemy, that enemy gets -2 [attack] and -2 [defense] until the end of the phase.
flavor:
Swiftly he returned and his wrath was redoubled, so that nothing could withstand him, and no weapon seemed to bite upon him. 
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Woodmen's Clearing
text: Attach to a location. Limit 1 per location. Response: When attached location leaves play as an explored location, the first player reduces his threat by 3.
flavor:
In spite of the dangers of this far land bold men had of late been making their way back into it from the South, cutting down trees, and building themselves places to live...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: The Hidden Way
text: Response: At the beginning of the quest phase, search the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for a location and make it the active location, returning any previous active location to the staging area. Then, reveal 1 less encounter card this phase (to a minimum of 0). Shuffle the encounter deck.

name: Long Lake Fisherman
text: Response: After Long Lake Fisherman enters play, name a number. Then, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a card whose printed cost is equal to that number and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

name: Grey Cloak
text: Attach to a [spirit] or Scout character. Limit 1 per character. Encounter Action: Exhaust attached character and discard Grey Cloak to choose a non-unique enemy in the staging area. That enemy does not make engagement checks against you this phase.

name: The Arkenstone
text: Guarded (enemy or location). Attach to a hero. Each unique character you control gains +1 [willpower]. Action: Reduce your threat by 2 to attach The Arkenstone to a hero controlled by another player and raise that player's threat by 2. (Limit once per round.)

name: Haldan
text: While the active location has an attachment on it, Haldan does not exhaust to quest. Response: When the active location is explored, draw 1 card for each attachment on it.

name: Wiglaf
text: Response: After you play Wiglaf, play an Item attachment on him from your hand for no cost. Action: Exhaust an attachment on Wiglaf to ready him. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Ancestral Armor
text: Attach to a [leadership] or Noble character. Restricted. Limit 1 per character Attached characters gets +2 [defense] and +2 hit points.
flavor: "May it keep you well!" said Theoden. "It was made for me in Thengel's day, while still I was a boy." - The Two Towers

name: Glamdring
text: Guarded (enemy or location) Attach to a hero or Gandalf. Restricted. Attached character gets +2 [attack] Response: After attached character destroys an enemy, draw 1 card.

name: Woodmen's Path
text:
Attach to a location with no progress tokens on it.
While attached location is the active location, reduce its quest point value to 1.
flavor:
It was a path made by strong arms and heavy feet.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Meneldor
text: Cannot have restricted attachments. Response: After Meneldor enters or leaves play, place 2 progress on a location.
flavor: ...Meneldor young and swift. -The Return of the King

name: Flight of the Eagles
text: Action: Return an Eagle ally to your hand to shuffle a set-aside Eagle of the North into the encounter deck. Then, remove Flight of the Eagles from the game.
flavor:
Behind them in long swift lines came all their vassals from the northern mountains, speeding on a gathering wind.
-The Return of the King

name: Wild Stallion
text: Cannot have attachments Planning Action: Attach Wild Stallion to an ally you control. (Counts as a Mount attachment with the text: "Restricted. Limit 1 per ally. Attached ally gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], +1 [defense], and +1 hit point.")

name: South Away!
text: Travel Action: Choose a location in the staging area with a player card attachment and make it the active location, returning any previous active location to the staging area. Reduce each player's threat by X, where X is the number of attachments on the active location.
flavor:
South away! and South away!
Seek the sunlight and the day
- The Hobbit

name: Eagle of the North
text: Encounter. Surge. Cannot have restricted attachments. When Revealed: The first player chooses a player to take control of Eagle of the North. The chosen player may choose and discard a non-unique enemy in the staging area.

name: Thranduil
text: Combat Action: Play a Silvan ally from your hand. You do not need a resource match for this ally. (Limit once per round.)
flavor:
"It is a crime to wander in my realm without leave."
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: The Elvenking
text: Attach to a Silvan hero. Action: Exhaust The Elvenking and return a Silvan ally you control to your hand to ready attached hero.
flavor:
In a great hall with pillars hewn out of the living stone sat the Elvenking on a chair of carven wood.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Orcrist
text: Guarded (enemy or location). Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +2 [attack]. Response: After attached hero destroys an enemy, add 1 resource to attached hero's pool.

name: Forest Road Traveler
text: Forest Road Traveler gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] for each attachment on the active location.
flavor:
Only on the Road would travellers be found...
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Leather Boots
text: Attach to a [lore] or Ranger character. Limit 1 per character. Response: After a location is revealed from the encounter deck, exhaust Leather Boots to ready attached character.
flavor:
His legs were stretched out before him, showing high boots of supple leather that fitted him well...
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Giant Bear
text: Cannot have attachments. Action: Ready Giant Bear. At the end of the phase in which you triggered this effect, shuffle Giant Bear back into your deck. (Limit once per phase.)
flavor:
"As a bear he ranges far and wide."
<cite>Gandalf, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Outmatched
text: Play into your play area unattached. If unattached, attach to the next eligible enemy that engages you. Response: After attached enemy resolves its attack, ready the defending character.

name: Galion
text: Cannot attack or defend. Response: After Galion enters play, he gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the round.
flavor:
"Here am I waiting and waiting down here, while you fellows drink and make merry and forget your tasks. Small wonder if I fall asleep from weariness!"
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Quicker Than Sight
text: Response: Return a Silvan ally you control to your hand to cancel a shadow effect just triggered during combat.
flavor:
"You would die before your stroke fell."
<cite>Legolas, Th Two Towers</cite>

name: Thalion
text:
While there is at least 1 side quest in the victory display, ready Thalion at the beginning of the combat phase. 
While there are at least 3 side quests in the victory display, Thalion loses the ally card type, gains the hero card type and the resource icons of each sphere on a side quest in the victory display.

name: Dáin Ironfoot
text: While Dáin Ironfoot is defending, he gains, 'Action: Discard the top card of your deck to give Dáin Ironfoot +1 [defense] for this attack. (Limit 3 times per phase.)'

name: Soldier of Erebor
text: Action: Discard the top 3 cards from your deck to ready Soldier of Erebor. (Limit once per round.)

name: Man the Walls
text: Play only if no other copies of Man the Walls have been played this round. Planning Action: Reduce the cost of the next ally played by each player this phase by 1. Those allies cannot quest this round.

name: Mirkwood Hunter
text:
Ranged.
Reduce the cost to play Mirkwood Hunter by 1 for each attachment on the active location.

name: Familiar Lands
text: Action: Each location with an attachment gets -2 [threat] until the end of the phase.

name: Warrior Sword
text: Restricted. Attach to a [tactics] or Warrior character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +1 [attack] for each enemy engaged with you. (Limit +3 [attack].)

name: Swift and Strong
text: Response: After a character you control attacks and destroys an enemy, exhaust a Weapon attached to that character to ready that character and give it +2 [attack] for its next attack this phase.

name: Descendant of Girion
text: Reduce the cost to play Item attachments on Descendant of Girion by 1.

name: Valiant Determination
text: Attach to an ally. Attached ally does not exhaust to quest.

name: Ring of Thrór
text: Guarded (enemy or location). Attach to a Dwarf hero. Action: Exhaust Thrór's Ring and discard the top card of your deck to ready attached hero. If the discarded card is an attachment, put it into play.

name: Bilbo Baggins
text: Response: After Bilbo Baggins commits to the quest, choose an enemy in the staging area. Until the end of the phase, Bilbo Baggins gets +X [willpower] where X is that enemy’s [threat]. If the players quest successfully, deal 1 damage to that enemy (2 damage instead if it is guarding a card).

name: Greenwood Defender
text: Response: After Greenwood Defender enters play, it does not exhaust to defend until the end of the round.
flavor: ...after the coming of Men they took ever more and more to the gloaming and the dusk. —The Hobbit

name: Elf Guide
text: Action: Return a Silvan ally you control to your hand to choose a hero. Add 1 resource to that hero’s pool.
flavor: ...soon Haldir turned aside into the trees and halted on the bank of the river under their shadows. —The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Gaffer Gamgee
text: Combat Action: Return Gaffer Gamgee to your hand to choose an enemy with engagement cost higher than your threat. Until the end of the round, that enemy cannot attack you.
flavor: "Why? Why’s none of my business, or yours." —The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Drinking Song
text: Action: Count the number of cards in your hand and shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw an equal number of cards. Draw 1 additional card if you control a unique Hobbit character.
flavor:
Ho! Ho! Ho! to the bottle I go 
To heal my heart and drown my woe. 
—The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Sting
text: Guarded (enemy). Attach to a Hobbit hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. Response: After attached hero is declared as an attacker or defender against an enemy, deal 1 damage to that enemy.

name: Round Shield
text: Attach to a character. Restricted. Response: After a shadow effect is triggered during combat, exhaust Round Shield to give attached character +2 [defense] for this attack.

name: Erebor Toymaker
text: Response: After you play Erebor Toymaker from your hand, reduce the cost of the next attachment played this phase by 2.
flavor: There were toys the like of which they had never seen before, all beautiful and some obviously magical. —The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Armor of Erebor
text:
Attach to a Dale or Dwarf character. Restricted. 
Attached character gets +1 [defense] and gains sentinel.
flavor: "We make good armour and keen swords, but we cannot again make mail or blade to match those that were made before the dragon came." —Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: The Shirefolk
text: Play only if each of your heroes is a Hobbit. Action: Reduce your threat by 4.
flavor: "If more of us valued food and cheer and song above hoarded gold, it would be a merrier world." —Thorin Oakenshield, The Hobbit

name: Radagast
text: While playing a Creature ally, Radagast gains the printed [leadership], [spirit], and [tactics] icons. Response: After you play a Creature card, Radagast does not exhaust to quest this round.
flavor:
"..he has much lore of herbs and beasts, and birds are especially his friends."
-Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Messenger Raven
text: Cannot attack, defend, of have attachments. Refresh Action: Return Messenger Raven to it's owner's hand and name a card type. Choose a player to look at the top card of his deck. If that card is the named type, add it to its owner's hand. If it is not, discard it.

name: The King's Return
text: Action: Search your deck for a Guarded attachment and put it into play. Shuffle your deck.
flavor:
His crown shall be upholden,
His harp shall be restrung,
His halls shall echo golden
To songs of yore re-sung
-The Hobbit

name: Loyal Hound
text: Cannot have attachments. Response: Discard Loyal Hound to cancel up to 2 damage just dealt to a hero you control.

name: The Great Hunt
text: You must use resources from 3 different heroes' pools to pay for this card. Combat Action: Choose and discard a non-unique enemy in the staging area.
flavor:
...it seemed they could hear the noise of a great hunt going by to the north of the path...
-The Hobbit

name: Bywater Shirriff
text: Bywater Shirriff gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] while you are engaged with an enemy with engagement cost higher than your threat.
flavor:
The Shirriffs was the name that the Hobbits gave to their police, or the nearest equivalent that they possessed.
-The Hobbit

name: Gwaihir's Debt
text: Play only if you control a unique character with the Istari trait and another unique character with the Eagle trait. Action: Search the top 5 cards of your deck for an Eagle or Istari ally and put it into play. Shuffle your deck. At the end of the round, if that ally is still in play, return it to your hand.

name: Mithril Shirt
text: Guarded (location). Guarded (location). Attach to a hero. Response: When attached hero is dealt any amount of damage, reduce that amount by 1.
flavor:
It was of silver-steel which the Elves call mithril, and with it went a belt of pearls and crystals.
-The Hobbit

name: Reforged
text: Action: Choose an Item attachment with a printed cost of X in any player's discard pile and play that attachment for no cost. (The chosen attachment can belong to any sphere of influence.)
flavor: The Sword of Elendil was forged anew by Elvish smiths... -The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Radagast's Staff
text: Attach to Radagast. Action: Exhaust Radagast's Staff to choose one: Reduce the cost of the next Creature ally you play this phase by 2, ready a Creature ally, or return a non-unique Creature enemy engaged with you to the staging area.

name: The One Ring
text: Restricted. Immune to non-Master card effects. Setup: Attach to a hero you control and search your deck for a Master card. Add it to your hand and shuffle your deck. Your threat elimination level is reduced by 5. If The One Ring leaves play, the players lose the game.

name: Frodo Baggins
text: Response: After Frodo Baggins commits to the quest, spend 1 resource from his resource pool to ready another unique character committed to the quest. If you quest successfully this phase, reduce your threat by 1.
flavor:
"Keep your tempers and hold your hands to the last possible moment!"
-The Return of the King

name: Merry
text: Response: After Merry enters play, each unique ally you control gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the round.
flavor:
"Shire-folk have been so comfortable so long they don"t know what to do. They just want a match, though, and they"ll go up in fire."
-The Return of the King

name: Pippin
text: Pippin gets +2 [attack] while attacking an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat. Response: After you engage an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat, ready Pippin.
flavor:
"Down on your knees in the road and ask pardon, or I will set this troll"s bane in you!"
-The Return of the King

name: Faramir
text: Response: After Faramir enters play, choose a non-unique enemy in the staging area. Engage that enemy and deal 2 damage to it (4 damage instead if it has an attachment on it).
flavor:
"There will be hard handstrokes nigh at hand ere the day is full."
-The Two Towers

name: Derufin
text: Ranged. Ranged. Response: After Derufin participates in an attack which destroys an enemy engaged with a player, discard Derufin to reduce the engaged player's threat by X, where X is the destroyed enemy's printed [threat].

name: The Gathering Storm
text: Planning Action: Search the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy. Add that enemy to the staging area to reduce the cost of the first ally you play this phase by X, where X is that enemy's [threat]. Shuffle the encounter deck.

name: Put Off Pursuit
text: Attach to the active location. Limit 1 per location. Attached location gets +2 quest points. Response: After attached location is explored, discard cards from the encounter deck until a location is discarded. Add that location to the staging area to choose an non-unique enemy in the staging area and shuffle it into the encounter deck.

name: The Master Ring
text: Response: Exhaust The One Ring and raise your threat by 1 to cancel the effects of an encounter card just revealed from the encounter deck and discard that card. Then, reveal an encounter card.
flavor:
"If I, wearing it, were to command you, you would obey, even if it were to leap from a precipice or to cast yourself into the fire."
-Frodo, The Two Towers

name: The Ruling Ring
text: Combat Action: Exhaust The One Ring and raise your threat by 1 to choose a non-Nazgul enemy engaged with you. Until the end of the phase, that enemy cannot attack you.
flavor:
"He vanished. I have never seen such a thing happen before..."
-Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: The Ring of Power
text: Action: Exhaust The One Ring and raise your threat by 1 to ready the hero with The One Ring Attached. That hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] until the end of the phase.
flavor:
"And behold! in our need chance brings to light the Ring of Power."
-Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Stinker
text: Surge. When Revealed: Gollum makes an immediate attack. If no attack was made this way, discard all tokens from Sméagol and flip him to Gollum. Shadow: Raise your threat by 2 (by 4 instead if Gollum is engaged with you). Shuffle Stinker back into the encounter deck.
shadow: Shadow: Raise your threat by 2 (by 4 instead if attacking enemy is Gollum). Shuffle Stinker back into the encounter deck.

name: Sméagol
text: Side A Cannot have attachments. Setup: Shuffle 2 copies of Stinker into the encounter deck. Response: After you travel to a location, raise your threat by 1 to draw 1 card. Side B Immune to non-Gollum card effects. Gollum engages the first player. Forced: When Gollum is defeated, flip him to Sméagol and return him to his owner's control, exhausted.

name: Fellowship
text: Side A You cannot play non-unique allies or put non-unique allies into play. Forced: When you control exactly 9 unique characters, flip this card over. Side B You cannot play allies or put allies into play. Each character you control gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. Forced: After a character you control leaves play, flip this card over.
flavor:
"I will choose you companions to go with you, as far as they will or fortune allows. The number must be few, since your hope is in speed and secrecy."
-Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring
"The company of the Ring shall be Nine; and the Nine Walkers shall be set against the Nine Riders that are evil."
-Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Thorin Stonehelm
text: Response: After Thorin Stonehelm is declared as an attacker, discard the top card of your deck to deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you.
flavor:
Thorin III Stonehelm, Dain"s son, became King under the mountain.
-The Return of the King

name: Soldier of Gondor
text: Response: After Soldier of Gondor enters play, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Gondor ally and add it to your hand (any number of Gondor allies instead if your threat is 40 or higher). Shuffle your deck.

name: Pillars of the Kings
text: While your threat is less than 40, reduce the cost to play Pillars of the Kings by 4. Action: Set your threat to 40. If this effect raised your threat, draw a card (draw 4 cards instead if it raised your threat by 10 or more).
flavor:
"Behold the Argonath, the Pillars of the Kings!"
-Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Cautious Halfling
text: Response: After Cautious Halfling enters play, look at the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is not an enemy, draw a card.
flavor:
"I thought I had been both careful and clever."
-Frodo, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Tom Bombadillo!
text: Play only if you control a Hobbit hero. You cannot play this card if there is a copy of Tom Bombadillo! in the victory display. Planning Action: Add Tom Bombadillo the the victory display to shuffle a set-aside copy of Tom Bombadil into the encounter deck.

name: Durin's Axe
text: Guarded (enemy). Restricted. Guarded (enemy). Restricted. Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +2 [attack]. Response: After attach hero attacks and destroys an enemy, deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you.

name: Charge into Battle
text: Play only after staging step. Quest Action: You may declare and resolve an attack against each non-unique enemy in the staging are as if it were engaged with you.
flavor:
Panic came upon the Goblins; and even as they turned to meet this new attack, the elves charged again with renewed numbers.
-The Hobbit

name: Silver Circlet
text: Restricted. Attach to a [spirit] hero. Limit 1 per hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +2 [willpower].
flavor:
His hair was dark as the shadows of twilight, and upon it was set a circlet of silver...
-The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Inner Strength
text: Attach to the hero with The One Ring. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets +1 [defense]. Response: Exhaust The One Ring and raise your threat by 1 to cancel a shadow effect just triggered during an attack that attached hero is defending.

name: Tom Bombadil
text: Encounter. When Revealed: Choose a player. That player gains control of Tom Bombadil, ready and committed to the quest. At the end of the round, remove Tom Bombadil and a copy of Tom Bombadillo! in the victory display from the game. This effect cannot be cancelled.

name: The Burglar's Turn
text: Side A You cannot include attachments in your deck. Setup: Choose 14 different Item or Artifact attachments from your collection and shuffle them together. This is your loot deck. Flip this card over and place your loot deck facedown under it. Side B The active location gets +1 quest point for each attachment attached to it. Forced: After you travel to a location, attach the top card of your loot deck faceup to that location as a guarded objective. If that attachment has the guarded X keyword, ignore it. Forced: When the active location is explored, you may put each guarded attachment on that location into play at no cost, or add it to your hand.
flavor:
"And I assure you there is a mark on this door - the usual one in the trade, or used to be. Burglar wants a good job, plenty of Excitement and reasonably Reward, that"s how it is usually read.
-Glóin, The Hobbit

name: Lothíriel
text: If Éomer is in play, Lothíriel gains the Rohan trait. Response: After Lothíriel commits to a quest, choose an ally in your hand. If that ally shares a Trait with her, put that ally into play exhausted and committed to the quest. At the end of the phase, if that ally is still in play, shuffle it into your deck.

name: Angbor the Fearless
text: While your threat is 40 or higher, Angbor the Fearless gets +2 [attack] and does not exhaust to quest.
flavor:
"Four thousands I sent marching from Pelargir through Lossarnach two days ago; and Angbor the fearless rides before them."
-Aragorn, The Return of the King

name: Need Drives Them
text: Action: Each player whose threat is 40 or higher readies all characters he controls.
flavor:
"But I do not go gladly; only need drives me. Therefore, only of your free will would I have you come..."
-Aragorn, The Return of the King

name: Woodland Sentry
text: Response: After you play Woodland Sentry from your hand, choose an enemy or location in play. If there is a copy of that card in the victory display, discard the chosen card.
flavor:
In the Wide World the Wood-elves lingered in the twilight of our Sun and Moon but loved best the stars...
-The Hobbit

name: Keen Longbow
text: Attach to a [lore] hero. Limit 1 per hero. Restricted. Attached hero gains ranged. Response: After attached hero is declared an as attacker against an enemy, discard up to 3 cards from your hand to deal 1 damage to that enemy for each card discarded this way.

name: War Axe
text:
Attach to a [tactics] character. Limit 1 per character. 
Restricted. 
Attached characters gets +1 [attack] for each attachment it has with the restricted keyword.
flavor:
"Gimli Glóin"s son, have you your axe ready?"
-Éomer, The Return of the King

name: Strength and Courage
text: Attach to the hero with The One Ring. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets +1 [attack]. Response: After attached hero is declared as an attacker, exhaust The One Ring and raise your threat by 1 to double attached hero's printed [attack] for this attack.

name: Knight of Belfalas
text: Response: After Knight of Belfalas enters play, return a Gondor ally from your discard pile to your hand.
flavor:
The mounted knights returned, and at their rear the banner of Dol Amroth...
-The Return of the King

name: Horn of the Mark
text: Attach to a Rohan hero or Merry. Restricted. Response: When a character leaves play, if that character shares at least one trait with the attached hero, exhaust Horn of the Mark to draw 1 card.
flavor:
Then Éowyn gave to Merry an ancient horn, small but cunningly wrought all of fair silver with a baldric of green...
-The Return of the King

name: Host of Galadhrim
text: Planning Action: Return each Silvan ally you control to your hand. Then, play each of those allies from your hand one at a time at no cost.
flavor:
Celeborn came forth and led the host of Lórien...
-The Return of the King

name: Forth, The Three Hunters!
text: Side A Your deck cannot include ally cards. Each of your heroes can have 1 additional restricted attachment. Reduce the cost of the first restricted attachment you play on each of your heroes each round by 1. Refresh Action: If each of your heroes has at least 2 restricted attachments, flip this card over. Side B Each of your heroes can have 1 additional restricted attachment and gets +1 [willpower] for each restricted attachment on it. Action: Exhaust this card to heal 1 damage from each of your heroes.
flavor:
"...we that remain cannot forsake our companions while we have strength left."
-Aragorn, The Two Towers
"With hope or without hope we will follow the trail of our enemies. And woe to them, if we prove the swifter!"
-Aragorn, The Two Towers

name: Saruman
text: When a player card effect would reduce your threat by any amount, reduce that amount to 1. While playing an event with the printed doomed keyword, Saruman gains the printed [leadership], [spirit], and [tactics] icons. Response: After you play a card with the doomed keyword, ready Saruman.

name: Power of Command
text: Attach to the hero with The One Ring. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower]. Response: After attached hero commits to the quest, exhaust The One Ring and raise your threat by 1 to give each other unique character you control +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.

name: Horns! Horns! Horns!
text: Doomed 2. Action: Each player may put one ally card into play from his hand. At the end of the phase, shuffle each of those allies that are still in play into their owners' decks.

name: Soldier of Isengard
text: Doomed 2. Response: After a player raises his threat from the doomed keyword, give control of Soldier of Isengard to that player.
flavor:
"...the keepers of the gate were on the watch for me and told me that Saruman awaited me."
-Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Far-sighted
text: Doomed 1. Action: Look at the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. Put them back in the same order.
flavor:
...Legolas was standing, gazing northwards into the darkness, thoughtful and silent as a young tree in a windless night.
-The Two Towers

name: Nori
text: Response: After Nori participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, put the top card of your discard pile on the bottom of your deck.
flavor:
"You've left the burglar behind again!"
-Nori, The Hobbit

name: Golden Belt
text:
Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. 
Attached hero can have 1 additional restricted attachment.
flavor:
The lady bowed her head, and she turned then to Boromir, and to him she gave a belt of gold...
-The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Rohirrim Scout
text: Action: Discard Rohirrim Scout to choose a non-unique enemy in the staging area. That enemy does not make engagement checks against you this round.
flavor:
Swiftly a scout rode back and reported that wolf-riders were abroad in the valley...
-The Two Towers

name: The Muster of Rohan
text: While paying for The Muster of Rohan, each Rohan hero you control is considered to have a [spirit] icon. Planning Action: Search the top 10 cards of your deck for up to 4 Rohan allies and put them into play. Shuffle your deck. If any of those allies are still in play at the end of the round, discard them.

name: Saruman's Staff
text: Attach to Saruman. Restricted. Action: Exhaust Saruman's Staff to (choose one): Reduce the X value of the next Doomed X event you play this phase by 2, or search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Doomed event and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.)
flavor:
His hand clutched his heavy black staff like a claw.
-The Two Towers

name: The Grey Wanderer
text: Side A You cannot choose more than 1 starting hero. Setup: Search your deck for an attachment with a printed cost of 1 and put it into play. Then, flip this card over. Side B The first non-unique card you play each planning phase does not require a resource match. Action: Exhaust this card and raise your threat by 1 to (choose two): Ready your starting hero, add 2 resources to your starting hero's resource pool, or heal 3 damage from your starting hero.
flavor:
"...the rule of no realm is mine, neither of Gondor nor any other, great or small. But all worthy things that are in peril as the world now stands, those are my care."
-Gandalf, The Return of the King
“...this shall be his great task, and maybe the end of his labours.”
–Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Gildor Inglorion
text: Action: Pay 1 resource from Gildor Inglorion's resource pool to choose a player to draw 1 card (Limit once per round.)
flavor:
"Gildor Inglorion of the House of Finrod. We are Exiles, and most of our kindred have long ago departed..."
-The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Wandering Exile
text: Response: After Wandering Exile commits to a quest, discard a card from your hand to ready Wandering Exile.
flavor:
"The Elves have their own labours and their own sorrows...
-Gildor, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Valiant Sword
text: Restricted. Attach to a Noble hero. Limit 1 per hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] if your threat is 40 or higher).
flavor:
...his sword of steel was valiant...
-The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Stone of Elostirion
text:
Guarded (location). Restricted.
Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +2 [willpower]. You draw 1 additional card during the resource phase.
flavor:
Looking up he saw before him a tall white tower, standing alone on a high ridge. A great desire came over him to climb the tower and see the Sea.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Well Preserved
text: Attach to the hero with The One Ring. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets + 1 hit point. Response: At the beginning of the round, exhaust The One Ring and raise your threat by 1 to heal all damage from attached hero.

name: Northern Bowmaster
text:
Ranged.
You cannot play Northern Bowmaster from your hand unless you are engaged with an enemy.

name: Reckless Attack
text: Doomed 2. Action: Each player deals 2 damage to an enemy engaged with him.
flavor:
Down, heedless of order, rushed all the dwarves of Dain to his help.
-The Hobbit

name: Odo Proudfoot
text: Response: After Odo Proudfoot enters play, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Hobbit ally and add it to your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
flavor:
"ProudFEET! shouted an elderly hobbit from the back of the pavilion.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Defiant Challenge
text: Doomed 2. Action: Each player may ready a character he controls.
flavor:
"Go back to the Shadow!"
-Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Helm of Secrecy
text: Limit 1 per deck. Action: Choose a hero you control and discard all tokens from it. Select a different non-[fellowship], non-[baggins] hero from your collection with a threat cost less than or equal to the chosen hero. Swap those heroes, moving all eligible attachments to the hero from your collection.

name: Council of the Wise
text: You cannot include more than 1 copy of a card, by title, in your deck. Response: After you play an event from your hand, choose one: reduce your threat by 1, draw 1 card, or add 1 resource to your hero's resource pool. You can only choose each option once per round.
flavor:
"I must go to this lords" council and learn what I can."
-Gandalf, The Return of the King

name: Gwaihir
text: Ranged. Sentinel. Cannot have restricted attachments. Gwaihir does not ready during the refresh phase. Response: After an Eagle ally enters or leaves play, ready Gwaihir. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Hobbit Archer
text:
Ranged.
Hobbit Archer gets +1 [attack] while attacking an enemy with a higher engagement cost than your threat.
flavor:
"If you lay a finger on this farmer, or on anyone else, you will be shot at once."
-Merry, The Return of the King

name: Red Book of Westmarch
text: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Restricted. While attached hero is committed to the quest, each Hobbit character gets +1 [willpower]. Response: After you quest successfully, exhaust Red Book of Westmarch to add 1 resource to attached hero's resource pool.

name: Dale Messenger
text: Response: After Dale Messenger enters play, choose a player. That player heals 1 damage from each character he controls with a player card attachment.
flavor:
"We discover that messengers have come also to King Brand in Dale..."
-Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Song of Healing
text: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Action: Discard 1 card from your hand to heal 1 damage from attached hero. Any player may trigger this effect.
flavor:
...behind him stood Galadriel, tall and white: a circlet of golden flowers was in her hair, and in her hand she held a hard, and she sang.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Eagle Emissary
text: Cannot have restricted attachments. Forced: After Eagle Emissary quests successfully, pay 1 [tactics] resource or discard it from play.
flavor:
...and out of the East there came a great Eagle flying, and he bore tidings beyond hope from The Lords of the West...
-The Return of the King

name: Bilbo's Plan
text: Response: After you attack and destroy an enemy, shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until an enemy is discarded. Add that enemy to the staging area to discard a non-unique location with [threat] equal to or less that that enemy's [threat].

name: Spare Pipe
text: Attach to a character. Attached character gets +1 hit point. Response: After you play Spare Pipe, search the top 5 cards of your deck for an event and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
flavor:
"I have carried it a long way, though I don"t know why."
-Pippin, The Two Towers

name: Smoke and Think
text: Action: Reduce the cost of the next card you play by 1 for each Pipe you control.
flavor:
Merry smiled. "Well then," he said, "if Strider will provide what is needed, I will smoke and think."
-The Return of the King

name: Wilyador
text: Ranged. Sentinel. Cannot have restricted attachments. Forced: At the end of the round, discard Wilyador unless the players as a group spend 1 resource.

name: Messenger of the King
text: Side A You cannot choose more than 2 heroes during setup. Setup: Choose a non-neutral unique ally from your deck and put it into play. Add the sum of that ally's printed [willpower], [attack], [defense], and hit points to your starting threat. Then, flip this card over and attach it to that ally. Side B Attached ally loses the ally card type and gains the hero card type Attached character cannot be readied more than once per phase Messenger of the King is immune to card effects while attached character is in play. If attached character leaves play, remove Messenger of the King from the game.
flavor:
"I am a messenger of the King" he said. "You are speaking to the King's friend, and one of the most renowned in all the lands of the West."
-Pippin, The Return of the King

name: Aragorn
text: Sentinel. Action: Exhaust Aragorn to choose a location in the staging area. Until the end of the phase, that location gets -X [threat], where X is Aragorn's [willpower]. If this effect reduces the location's [threat] to 0, place 1 progress on it. (Limit once per round.)

name: Shining Shield
text: Attach to a Noble hero. Limit 1 per hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [defense] (+2 [defense] instead if your threat is 40 or higher).
flavor:
...his shinning shield was scored with runs...
-The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Knowledge of the Enemy
text: Planning Action: Choose a hero you control. Add 1 resource to its resource pool for each enemy engaged with you. You can only play 1 Knowledge of the Enemy each round.
flavor:
"If a man must needs walk in sight of the Black Gate, or tread the deadly flowers of Morgul Vale, then perils he will have."
-Aragorm, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Haleth
text: Response: After Haleth quests successfully, search the top 5 cards of your deck for an attachment and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

name: Woodman Lore
text: Action: Ready up to X Woodman characters you control, where X is the number of locations with player card attachments.
flavor:
The Woodman said that there was some new terror abroad...
-The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Westfold Lancer
text: Response: After Westfold Lancer quests successfully, discard it to choose a non-unique enemy in the staging area. Deal 2 damage to the chosen enemy.
flavor:
...the white fury of the Northmen burned the hotter, and more skilled was their knighthood with long spears...
-The Return of the King

name: Tireless Thoroughbred
text: Restricted. Attach to a Warrior character. Restricted. Attached character gains ranged and sentinel.
flavor:
Then he leapt forward, spurring the earth, and was gone like the north wine from the mountains.
-The Two Towers.

name: Misty Mountain Journeyman
text: You cannot play Misty Mountain Journeyman from your hand unless you are engaged with an enemy.
flavor:
Rangers passed at times beyond the hills, but they were few and did not stay.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

name: A Desperate Path
text: Response: At the end of the staging step, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until you discard a treachery. Resolve its 'when revealed' effects to ready each of your questing characters. Each of your questing characters gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.

name: Thorongil
text: Attach to a non-[fellowship], non-[baggins] hero you control. Response: After you attach Thorongil to a hero, search your collection for a different non-[fellowship], non-[baggins] version of that hero and attach it to Thorongil. While Thorongil is in play, attached hero gains the game text and resource icon of the attached hero card. If Thorongil leaves play, remove the hero card attached to it from the game.

name: Bond of Friendship
text:
Your deck must be exactly 50 players cards and include exactly 10 cards from each of these four spheres: [leadership], [lore], [spirit], and [tactics]. You cannot include more than 2 copies of any card by title in your deck.

When choosing your starting heroes, you may choose 4 heroes instead of 3. Each of your heroes must belong to a different sphere.
flavor:
"You can trust us to stick to you through think and thin - to the bitter end."
-Merry, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: A Perilous Voyage
text: Side A Your minimum deck size is 100 cards. Your threat cannot be reduced by player card effects. Action: Exhaust this card and raise your threat by 1 to look at the top 2 cards of your deck, draw 1, and place the other on the bottom of your deck. Forced: When you would be eliminated by reaching your threat elimination level, flip this card over instead. Side B Your threat cannot be reduced by non-contract player card effects. Heroes you control do not exhaust to quest. Forced: When this card is flipped to this side, reduce your threat by 10. Search your deck for a card and either add it to your hand or play it, reducing its cost by 3. Shuffle your deck.
flavor:
Thus came Aragorn... borne upon a wind from the Sea to the kingdom of Gondor...
-The Return of the King

name: Stalking Goblin
text: Forced: After Stalking Goblin engages you, search the encounter deck, discard pile, and your collection (in that order) for a Goblin Sniper and add it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck. Shadow: Add Stalking Goblin to the staging area.
shadow: Shadow: Add Stalking Goblin to the staging area.

text: Surge. Doomed 1. When Revealed: Each player may add 1 resource to each of their heroes' pools. Each player that does raises their threat by 5.

text: Surge. When Revealed: Attach to the hero with the highest threat cost. (Counts as an Adaptation attachment with the text: "Forced: Raise your threat by 2 at the end of each round. Action: Spend 2 resources from attached hero's pool to discard this card.")
